verses.text: Yahweh in Mosheh hopih a, Kikhopna Puanbuk panin Yahweh in amah a hopih inah:

“Israyl mite sam inla, amaute’ tungah, ‘Note khatpeuh in Yahweh tungah biakna khatpeuh na paipih uh ciangun, note in na ganhingte uh panin na bawnghonte panin hitaleh na tuuhonte panin hitaleh na biakna uh na paipih ding uh hi.
Ama biakna pen bawnghon panin MEIHAL BIAKNA khat ahih leh, a sitbaang lo a pa khat na piasak ding uh hi. Yahweh’ mai, Kikhopna Puanbuk kongkhak ah amah in uttawmna hanga biakna a paipih ding hi.
Amah in a meihal biakna ganhing lu’ tungah a khut nga ding a, tua ciangin ama aa dingin mawhkhuhna a bawlsak dingin tua ganhing pen ama tang dingin kisang ding hi.
Amah in Yahweh mai-ah tua bawngtal go ding hi; Aaron’ tapa siampite in a sisan hong paipih-in Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna-a biaknatau kiimkotah a sisan theh ding hi.
Amah in meihal biakna ganhing a vun hawkin semnen ding hi.
Aaron’ tapa siampite in biaknatau tungah mei koihin, mei tungah hoih takin sing a koih ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin Aaron’ tapa siampite in a kisemnente a lu leh a thau zong kihelin biaknatau tung mei tunga om sing tungah hoih takin gual ding hi.

Ahih hangin a masa-in amah in a sungkuate leh a khete tui tawh sawp ding a, tua khit ciangin siampipa in mei tawh kihal biakna, Yahweh’ tungah a lungkim huai gimnamtui, meihal biakna-in biaknatau tungah a vekin hal ding hi.
Ahih hangin ama biakna pen tuu hitaleh keelte hitaleh a hon lak panin meihal biakna ahih leh, amah in a sitbaang lo a pa khat paipih ding hi.
Amah in Yahweh mai, biaknatau’ leilu lam ah a ganhing go ding hi; Aaron’ tapa siampite in biaknatau tung kiimkotah a sisan theh ding hi.
Amah in a lu leh a thau kihelin tua pen semnen ding hi; siampipa in a kisemnen teng pen biaknatau-a mei tunga om sing tungah hoih takin nga ding hi.

Ahih hangin a masa-in amah in a sungkuate leh a khete tui tawh sawp ding a, tua khit ciangin siampipa in tua khempeuh paipih-in biaknatau tungah hal ding hi. Hih pen Yahweh tungah a lungkimhuai gimnamtui mei tawh kihal biakna, meihal biakna khat ahi hi.
Ahih hangin Yahweh tungah ama meihal biakna pen vasate tawh ahih leh, tua ciangin amah in vakhu pan ahih keileh kawl vakhu panin a meihal biakna paipih ding hi.
Siampipa in tua pen biaknatau tungah paipih ding a, a lu heektatin biaknatau tungah hal ding hi; biaknatau pang ah a sisan takkhiasak ding hi.
Vasa a kihal ma-in, siampipa in a tangkhai leh a multe botkhia ding a, biaknatau pang nisuahna lam vut koihna sungah pai ding hi.

Tua ciangin amah in a khate panin balkek ding a, ahih hangin baltat lo ding hi; tua ciangin siampipa in biaknatau tung mei tunga a kigual sing tungah tua pen hal ding hi. Hih pen Yahweh’ tungah dingin a lungkimhuai gimnamtui, mei tawh kihal biakna, meihal biakna khat ahi hi.
Mi khatpeuh in Yahweh tungah AN tawh BIAKNA hong paipih ciangin ama biakpiakna pen annel limci hi ding hi. Amah in annel tungah sathau sung ding a, a tungah gim namtui koih ding hi.

Amah in tua pen Aaron’ tapa siampite kiangah paipih ding hi. Siampi khat in tua sung panin annel limci khut dim khat, sathau, leh a gim namtui khempeuh la ding a, tua siampipa in Yahweh’ tungah a gim namtui, mei tawh kihal biakna, phawkna satanh khatin hal ding hi.
An tawh biakna a satanh val lai teng pen Aaron’ leh a tapate aa ding ahi ding hi. Hih pen Yahweh’ tungah mei tawh kihal a siangtho pen biakna khat ahi hi.
Na biakpiakna pen mei bung sunga ki-em an tawh biakna ahih leh, sathau tawh kipawi silngo kisawh lo mohte ahih keileh sathau kizut silngo kisawh lo mohphengte hi ding hi.
Na biakpiakna pen beelpei dai tunga kibawl an tawh biakna ahih leh, silngo kisawh lo; sathau tawh kipawi annel limci tawh kibawl hi ding hi.
Tua pen balnenin a tungah sathau na sung ding hi; tua pen an tawh biakna khat ahi hi.
Na biakpiakna pen sikbeel sunga ki-em an tawh biakna ahih leh, sathau tawh kibawl annel limci hi ding hi.
Hih nate tawh kibawl an tawh biakna, Yahweh’ tungah na paipih ding hi. Siampi tungah na ap ding a, amah in biaknatau ah a paipih ding hi.
Tua ciangin siampipa in Yahweh’ tungah a gim namtui, mei tawh kihal biakna-in biaknatau tungah a kihal dingin phawkna satanh an tawh biakna teng la ding hi.
An tawh biakna a vallai peuhmah Aaron’ leh a tapate aa ding ahi hi. Hih pen Yahweh’ tungah mei tawh kihal a siangtho pen biakna khat ahi hi.

Yahweh’ tungah na paipih uh an tawh biakna peuhmah silngo tawh a kibawl hi lo ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh mei tawh kihal Yahweh’ tungah biakna peuhmah ah silngo ahi-a, a khum khatpeuh ahi zongin na hal kei ding uh hi.

* Note an tawh biaknate peuhmah ci na sawh ding uh hi; note an tawh biakna ah Yahweh’ thuciamna ci sawh loin na om kei ding uh hi. Na biakpiaknate khempeuh ci na sawh ding uh hi. 13* Note in Yahweh kiangah na anpalte uh na paipih thei uh hi. Ahih hangin tuate pen a lungkimhuai gim namtui dingin biaknatau tungah kihal lo ding hi.
Na anpalte panin Yahweh’ tungah an tawh biakna na piak uh leh a vui thak panin a kila a kigawi-vui, mei-a kihangkeu na pia ding uh hi.
Tua tungah sathau koihin gim namtui zong na koih ding uh hi. Hih pen an tawh biakna khat ahi hi.
Tua ciangin siampipa in phawkna satanh ahi: a kigawi-vui annel khut dim khat, a sathau, a lungkimhuai gim namtui khempeuh Yahweh’ tungah mei tawh kihal biakna-in hal ding hi.
Biakpiakna khatpeuh pen KILEMNA BIAKNA ahih ciangin ganhon lak panin a nu ahi a, a pa ahi zongin kipaipih ding hi. Tua ganhing pen Yahweh mai-ah a sitbaang lo hi ding hi.
A pia pen in a biakpiakna ganhing lu’ tungah a khut nga ding a, Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna ah tua ganhing go ding hi. Aaron’ tapa siampite in biaknatau tung kiimkotah a sisan theh ding uh hi.
Kilemna biakna panin Yahweh’ tungah mei tawh kihal biakna-in a sungkuate a tuam a thaute leh a sungkuate-a om a thau khempeuh,
a kal nihte, a kawngnuai kiim-a om a thaute, a kalte tunga om a sin, a sin tunga a thaute amah in pia ding hi. Hih satanhte amah in hemkhia ding hi;
tua khit ciangin Aaron’ tapate in mei tawh kihal biakna Yahweh’ tungah a lungkimhuai gim namtui-in mei tunga om sing a kuanglai tung, meihal biakna tung, biaknatau tungah tuate hal ding uh hi.
Amah in Yahweh’ tungah kilemna biakna a piak dingin ganhon lak panin ganhing khat a piak leh, amah in a sitbaang lo a pa ahih keileh a nu khat a pia ding hi.
Amah in kilemna biakna-in tuuno khat a piak leh, amah in Yahweh mai-ah pia ding hi.
Amah in a kilemna biakna ganhing tungah a khut nga ding a, Kikhopna Puanbuk mai-ah go ding hi; tua ciangin Aaron’ tapate in biaknatau tung kiimkotah a sisan theh ding uh hi.
Kilemna biakna panin Yahweh’ tungah mei tawh kihal biakna-in a thau leh a nungguh ciangah a ki-attan a mei thau buppi, leh a sungkuate tunga a thau khempeuh,
a kal nihte, a kawngnuai kiim-a om a thaute, a kalte tunga om a sin, a sin tunga a thaute amah in pia ding a, amah in hihte hemkhia ding hi;
siampipa in Yahweh’ tungah mei tawh kihal an tawh biakna-in biaknatau tungah hihte hal ding hi.
Ama kilemna biakna pen keel khat tawh ahih leh, tua ciangin amah in Yahweh mai-ah pia ding hi.
Amah in a ganhing lu tungah a khut nga ding a, Kikhopna Puanbuk mai-ah go-in, Aaron tapate in biaknatau tung kiimkotah a sisan theh ding uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yahweh’ tungah mei tawh kihal biakna-in a sungkuate a tuam a thaute, a sungkuate’ tunga a thau khempeuh,
a kal nihte, a kawngnuai kiim-a om a thaute, a kalte tunga om a sin, a sin tunga a thaute amah in pia ding hi. Hihte amah in hemkhia ding hi.
Tua ciangin siampipa in a gim namtui aa dingin mei tawh kihal an tawh biakna-in biaknatau tungah hihte hal ding hi. Hih a thaute khempeuh Yahweh a’ ahi hi.
Hih pen note tenna munte ah na khang khangun tawntung ngeina kip khat ahi hi: Note in hih a thaute ahi a, sisan ahi zongin na ne kei ding uh hi,’ ci-in,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh hopih a, a gen inah:

“Israyl mite tungah gen in, ‘Mi khatpeuh in a ki gamta lo ding Yahweh’ thupiakte khatpeuh theih lohna hangin; sawm lo pi-in, khialin, amaute in a khaam uh khatpeuh a gamtat leh, hihte pen Keima thukham ahi hi.
Sathau kinilh siampi mawh a, mite tungah mawhna a tut leh, tua ciangin amah in a khialhsa mawhna hanga biakna dingin a sitbaang lo bawngtalno khat Yahweh’ tungah MAWHNA HANGA BIAKNA-in pia ding hi.
Amah in Yahweh mai, Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna ah tua bawngtal pai pih ding hi. Amah in a bawngtal’ lu tungah a khut nga ding a, Yahweh mai-ah bawngtal a go ding hi.
Tua ciangin sathau kinilh siampipa in bawngtal sisan tawmkhat la-in Kikhopna Puanbuk sungah a paipih ding hi.
Siampipa in tua sisan sungah a khutme diah ding a, Yahweh mai, Mun Siangtho Dalna puan mai-ah tua sisan tawmkhat sagih vei theh ding hi.

Siampipa in Kikhopna Puanbuk sunga om Yahweh mai-a paknamtui biaknatau’ kite tungah tua sisan tawmkhat zut ding hi. Amah in tua khit ciangin bawngtal’ sisan a cianlai teng pen Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna-a; buktual sunga, om meihal biaknatau phungah sungsuk ding hi.
Mawhna hanga biakna-in amah in bawngtal’ thau khempeuh a sungkuate a tuam a thaute leh a sungkuate-a om a thau khempeuh,
a kal nihte, a kawngnuai kiim-a om a thaute, a kalte tunga om a sin, a sin tunga a thaute amah in pia ding hi. Hihte amah in hemkhia ding hi.
Kilemna biakna lawi pan ahi a, bawng panin ahi zongin a lakkhiat bang tektekin hihte amah in lakhia ding hi; tua ciangin siampipa in meihal biaknatau tungah hihte hal ding hi.
Ahih hangin bawngtal’ lu leh a khete, a sungkuate leh a ekte tawh a vun leh a sate khempeuh—
Amah in giahphual pua lamah vutte a kibuakna a sianna mun ah a bawngtal buppi paikhiatpih ding a, sing tungah tua pen mei tawh hal ding hi. Vutte a kibuakna mun ah tua pen kihal ding hi.

Tu-in Israyl mihon buppi in theih lohna hangin mawhna bawl kha-in, Yahweh’ Thukhamte sunga a kikhaam khatpeuh a gamtat khak leh, mihonpi in hih mawhna a phawkkhak loh uh hangun: amaute a khial uh hi veve hi.
Amaute’ khialh tua mawhna a kitheih ciangin mihonte in bawngtal khanglai khat Kikhopna Puanbuk mai-ah paipih-in mawhna hanga biakna-in pia ding uh hi.
Mihon’ upate in Yahweh’ mai, bawngtal’ lu tungah a khut uh nga ding hi. Tua khit ciangin Yahweh mai-ah tua bawngtal kigo ding hi.
Sathau kinilh siampipa in Kikhopna Puanbuk sungah bawngtal’ sisan kimkhat paipih ding hi;
Tua khit ciangin siampipa in tua sisan sungah a khutme diah ding a, Yahweh mai, Dalna puan mai-ah tua sisan sagih vei theh ding hi.

Amah in Kikhopna Puanbuk sunga om Yahweh’ mai-a paknamtui biaknatau’ kite tungah tua sisan tawmkhat zut ding hi. Amah in a cianlai sisante pen Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna-a; buktual sunga, om meihal biaknatau phungah sungsuk ding hi.
Amah in tua bawngtal panin a kisehsa a thau khempeuh la-in biaknatau tungah a hal ding hi.
Amah in mawhna hanga biakna’ bawngtal a hih sa mah bangin hih bawngtal a hih hi; tua bangin amah in ahih hi. Siampipa in mihon buppi aa dingin mawhkhuhna bawlsak ding a, amaute kimaisak ding hi.
Tua ciangin amah in giahphual pualam ah bawngtal paikhiatpih ding a, amah in a masa bawngtal a hal mah bangin a hal ding hi. Hih pen mihonpi aa dingin mawhna hanga biakna khat ahi hi.
Ukpa khat in sawm lo pi-in mawhna bawlkha-in, i Pa Yahweh’ Thukhamte sunga a kikhaam khatpeuh a gamtat khak leh, amah a khial ahi hi.
Amah in a khialhsa mawhna a phawkkik ciangin, keelte lak panin a pa khat; a sitbaang lo keel a pa khat, amah in mawhna hanga biakna-in paipih ding hi.
Amah in a keel’ lu tungah a khut nga ding a, Yahweh’ mai, meihal biakna gan a gawhna munah tua gan a go ding hi; hih pen mawhna hanga biakna ahi hi.
Siampipa in mawhna hanga biakna sisan tawmkhat a khutme tawh la-in, meihal biaknatau kite tungah zut ding a, meihal biaknatau phungah a sisante sungsuk ding hi.

Amah in kilemna biakna a thaute a kihal mah bangin a kisehsa a thau khempeuh biaknatau tungah hal ding hi. Ukpa, ama mawhna tawh kisai thu hangin siampipa in mawhkhuhna bawlsak ding a, a mawhna kimaisak ding hi.
Mihonpi laka mi khat peuh in sawm lo pi-in mawhna a bawlkha-in, Yahweh’ Thukhamte sunga a kikhaam khatpeuh a gamtat leh, amah a khial ahi hi.
Amah in a khialhsa a mawhna a phawkkik ciangin amah in a sitbaang lo keel a nu khat mawhna hanga biakna-in paipih ding hi.
Amah in mawhna hanga biakna ganhing’ lu tungah a khut nga ding a, meihal biakna munah mawhna hanga biakna ganhing go ding hi.
Tua khit ciangin siampipa in a sisan tawmkhat a khutme tawh la-in, meihal biaknatau kite tungah zut ding a, meihal biaknatau phungah a sisante sungsuk ding hi.

Kilemna biakna panin a thaute a kilakkhiat mah bangin a kisehsa a thau khempeuh amah in lakhia ding hi; tua ciangin Yahweh’ tungah a lungkimhuai gim namtui dingin siampipa in biaknatau tungah tua pen hal ding hi.
Amah in mawhna hanga biakna-in tuuno khat a paipih leh, amah in a sitbaang lo a nu khat paipih ding hi.
Tua khit ciangin amah in ama mawhna hanga biakna ganhing lu tungah a khut nga ding a, amaute in meihal biakna ganhing a gawhna munah mawhna hanga biakna-in tua ganhing a go ding hi.
Siampipa in a mawhna hanga biakna sisan kimkhat a khutme tawh la-in, meihal biaknatau kite tungah zut dinga, a cianlai sisante biaknatau phungah sungsuk ding hi.

Amah in kilemna biakna piakna-a tuuno’ thaute a kilakkhiat dan mah bangin a kisehsa a thau khempeuh lakhia ding hi. Tua ciangin siampipa in biaknatau tung, Yahweh’ tungah mei tawh kihal biakna tungah tua pen hal ding hi. Tua ciangin siampipa in tuapa khialhsa mawhna hangin mawhkhuhna bawlsak ding a, a mawhna kimaisak ding hi.
Mi khatpeuh in a muhsa ahih keileh a theihsa thu khat peuh teci pang dingin mipi’ sawlna a zak ciangin amah in genkhia nuam lo-in a mawh leh, amah in tua mawhna pua ding hi;

Tua ahih keileh mi khatpeuh in a siang lo na khatpeuh, a siang lo ganhing a sisa hitaleh, a siang lo a kikhawi ganhing sisa hitaleh, a siang lo a bokvak ganhing sisa hitaleh lawngkha-in a theihkhak loh a hih phial leh zong, amah a sianglo suak ding a, a khial ahi hi;
Tua ahih keileh amah in mihing sianlohna, pasal’ vang a kiamsak thei na khatpeuh lawngkha-in, a theihkhak loh ahih phial leh zong, amah in a theih ciangin, a khial mah hi veve hi.

Tua ahih keileh mi khatpeuh in a sia bawl ding ahi a, a pha bawl ding ahi zongin mi khat in kiciamna-in a paukhiat kammal peuhmah, a kam tawh pheng pausuk gawpin kiciamna khatpeuh a kiciam a, a theihkhak loh a hih phial leh zong, amah in tua thu a theih ciangin, amah a khial hi ding hi.
Hih bang thute khatpeuh ah mi khatpeuh in a khialh ciangin, tua thu-a a gamtatsa mawhna amah in pulaak ding hi.

Amah in a gamtatsa ama mawhna hangin Yahweh’ tungah a GAMTAT KHIALHNA HANGA BIAKNA-in a ganhon lak panin tuuno a nu khat ahih keileh keelno khat mawhna hanga biakna bangin paipih ding hi. Tua ciangin ama mawhna thu hangin siampipa in mawhkhuhna bawlsak ding hi.

Amah in tuuno khat a neih zawh kei leh, tua ciangin amah in ama khialhsa a gamtat khialhna hangin Yahweh’ tungah biakna-in vakhu nih ahi a, kawl vakhu nih ahi zongin paipih ding a, khat pen mawhna hanga biakna-in, leh a khat pen meihal biakna-in a pia ding hi.
Amah in mawhna hanga biakna-in a pia siampipa kiangah tuate paipih masa ding a, a ngawng panin a lu heektan ding a, ahih hangin heeksat lo ding hi.
Tua ciangin amah in mawhna hanga biakna sisan kimkhat biaknatau pang tungah theh-in, a cianlai sisan teng pen biaknatau phungah luangsuksak ding hi. Hih pen mawhna hanga biakna khat ahi hi.

Tua ciangin amah in ngeina kip om mah bangin meihal biakna-in a nihna vasa pen pia ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin siampipa in a gamtatnasa a mawhna hangin ama tangin mawhkhuhna bawlsak ding a, a mawhna kimaisak ding hi.

Ahih hangin amah in vakhu nih ahi a, kawl vakhuno a neih zawh kei leh, a mawh mipa in ama gamtat khialhna hangin mawhna hanga biakna-in annel limci ephah seh-sawm-suah-seh-khat paipih ding hi. Amah in tua tungah sathau khat zong koih lo ding a, amah in tua tungah a gim namtui khat zong koih lo ding hi, bang hang hiam cihleh hih pen mawhna hanga biakna khat ahi hi.

Tua ciangin amah in tua pen siampipa kiangah paipih ding a, siampipa in phawkna satanh-in tua panin khut dim khat la ding a, Yahweh’ tungah mei tawh kihal biakna bawldan tawh kizui-in biaknatau tungah a khut dim khat hal ding hi. Hih pen mawhna hanga biakna khat ahi hi.

Siampipa in ama aa ding, ama khialhsa ama mawhna hangin mawhkhuhna bawlsak ding hi; hih in amah maisak ding hi. An tawh biakna mah bangin hih annel a cianlai satanh pen siampipa aa ding ahi hi,’ ci in,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh hopihin, a gen inah:

“Mi khatpeuh in gamtat khialhna khat gamta kha-in Yahweh’ na a siangthote khatpeuh tungah theih lohna tawh a mawh khak leh, tua ciangin ama gamtat khialhna hanga biakna-in tuuhon sung panin a sitbaang lo tuutal khat, munsiangtho shekel tawh kizui-in, gamtat khialhna hanga kipia ding ngun a man kiseh zah, gamtat khialhna hanga biakna bangin amah in Yahweh’ kiangah paipih ding hi.

Amah in a siangtho na tungah ahih khitsa siatna aa dingin amah in ditkikna bawl ding a, a van man zah panin seh-nga-suah-seh-khat gawm behin siampipa tungah pia ding hi; siampipa in ama aa dingin gamtat khialhna hanga biakna tuutal tawh mawhkhuhna bawlsak ding a; a mawhna kimaisak ding hi.

Mi khat peuh mawh-in, Yahweh’ Thukhamte tawh kizui-in gamtat loh dinga a kikhaam hih nate khatpeuh a palsat leh, amah in hih thu a theih loh hangin, amah a khial hi a, ama gamtat siatna amah in pua ding hi.

Amah in siampipa kiangah a manzah dingin nangmah in nasehsa zah tawh tuuhon lak panin a sitbaang lo khat gamtat khialhna hanga biakna-in paipih ding hi. Tua ciangin ama theih lohna hang, a khialhna hang leh tua a theih lohna hangin siampipa in mawhkhuhna bawlsak ding a, tua in amah maisak ding hi.
Hih pen gamtat khialhna hanga biakna khat ahi hi; Yahweh’ tungah a gamtat khialkhit taktakna hang ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh hopih a, a gen inah:

“Mi khatpeuh in na a kepsakna thu ah ahi zongin, khapna thu ah ahi zongin, van a kiguksakna thu ah ahi zongin, a sanggampa tungah khemna tawh Yahweh’ tungah gamta khialin a mawh leh ahi zongin, amah in a sanggampa kiang panin khem-in ngianvat ahi zongin,
amah in a mang khatpeuh mu-in tua thu ah zuau-in a man lopi-in a kiciam leh ahi zongin, hih nate khatpeuh ah mi khatpeuh a gamtat leh a mawh ahi hi;

Tua ciangin amah mawhkhin-in a khialhna hangin hi bang hih ding hi: amah in a guksate hitaleh, khemna tawh a ngahsa na hitaleh, ama kiangah muanna tawh a kikemsak peuhmah hitaleh, ama muh a mang khatpeuh hitaleh piakik ding hi;

bang hang hiam cihleh a man lopi-in amah kiciamkhin hi. Amah in a cing a manzah ah seh-nga-suah-seh-khat gawmbeh-in piakik ding a, ama gamtat khialhna hanga biakna a piak ni-in a nei peuhpeuh tungah pia ding hi.
Tua ciangin amah in ama gamtat khialhna hanga biakna-in a man ding nangma sehzah tawh tuuhon lak panin a sitbaang lo tuutal khat Yahweh’ tungah piak dingin siampipa kiangah paipih ding hi.
Tua ahih manin siampipa in ama aa dingin Yahweh mai-ah mawhkhuhna bawlsak ding a, ama gamtatsa hih nate khatpeuh gamtat khialhna panin amah kimaisak ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh hopih a, a gen inah:

“Aaron leh a tapate thupia inla, hih bangin gen in, ‘MEIHAL BIAKNA ngeina hih bang ahi hi: meihal biakna pen biaknatau-a meikhuk tawphah tungah zingsang mateng zan tawntung om ding a, tua tungah biaknatau’ mei kikuang saksak ding hi.
Tua ciangin siampipa in a saihadial puan silhin, a sunglam-a kisilh saihadial puante silhin, biaknatau tunga meihal biakna mei in a kattum vutte la-in biaknatau pangah koih ding hi.
Tua khit ciangin amah in a puante suahkhia-in, adang puante silh ding a, giahphual pualam a siangtho mun ah vutte tawikhia ding hi.

Biaknatau tunga mei pen tua tungah kuang suaksuak ding hi. Tua pen kilakhia lo ding hi. Siampipa in zingsang simin tua tungah sing cih ding a, tua sing tungah hoih takin meihal biakna koih ding hi; amah in kilemna biakna’ a thaute tua tungah hal ding hi.
Mei pen biaknatau tungah kikuang paisuaksak ding hi; tua pen kipusuah peuhmah lo ding hi.
Hih pen AN TAWH BIAKNA ngeina ahi hi: Aaron’ tapate in biaknatau tung Yahweh mai-ah pia ding uh hi.

Amah in an tawh biakna annel limci panin khut dim khat, a sathau leh an tawh biakna tunga om a gim namtui khempeuh tawh la ding a, Yahweh’ tungah phawkna, a lungkimhuai gim namtui dingin biaknatau tungah hal ding hi.
Tua a cianlai teng pen Aaron leh a tapate in ne ding uh hi. Silngo Sawh loh Anlum bangin tua pen kine ding hi; mun siangtho sung, Kikhopna Puanbuk tual sung khatah amaute in tua ne ding uh hi.

Tua pen silngo tawh ki-em lo ding hi. Mei tawh kihal Ka biaknate panin amaute’ satanh dingin amaute tungah ka piakhin hi. Hih pen mawhna hanga biakna leh, gamtat khialhna hanga biakna mah bangin a siangtho pen ahi hi.

Aaron’ ta pasal khempeuh in tua pen ne thei ding uh hi. Yahweh’ tungah mei tawh kibawl biakna tawh kisai-in hih pen note khang tawntungin a kip tawntung ngeina kip khat ahi hi. Tuate a lawng peuhmah a siangtho ahi ding hi,’ ci-in gen in,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh hopih a, a gen inah:

“Hih pen Aaron leh a tapate in sathau’ a kinilh ni-in Yahweh tungah a piak ding uh amaute’ biakna ahi hi: nisim an tawh biakna-in annel limci ephah seh-sawm-suah-seh-khat hi ding hi; tua panin a lang pen zingsangin biakna-in pia ding a, a lang mah pen nitak-in biakna-in pia ding hi.
Tua pen beelpei tung khatah sathau tawh kibawl ding hi; limtakin helsa-in paipih inla, Yahweh’ tungah a lungkimhuai gim namtui-in an tawh biakna balnensa-in paipih in.
A tapate lak panin ama za a luah dingin sathau kinilh siampipa in tua pen hih ding hi. Hih pen Yahweh’ tungah a kip tawntung ngeina kip khat ahi hi. Hih pen kihal tum sitset ding hi.
Siampi khatpeuh’ an tawh biakna peuhmah pen kihal tum sitset ding a, tua pen kine peuhmah lo ding hi,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh hopih a, a gen inah:

“Aaron leh a tapate kiangah hih bangin genin, ‘Hih pen MAWHNA HANGA BIAKNA ahi hi: meihal biakna ganhing a kigawhna mun ah, mawhna hanga biakna ganhing zong Yahweh mai-ah kigo ding hi. Hih pen a siangtho ahi hi.
Mawhna hanga tua ahih siampipa in tua pen ne ding hi. Tua pen mun siangtho sung, Kikhopna Puanbuk buktual sungah kine ding hi.
A satak a lawng peuhmah a siangtho hi ding hi. A sisan pen puan tung khatpeuh ah a kitheh ciangin, nangmah in a siangtho mun khat ah tua sisan a kithehkha pen na sawp ding hi.
Ahih hangin tua sa a kihuanna leibeel kisukham ding hi. Tua pen sumngo beel sungah a kihuan ahih leh, a beel nawt siangin tui sungah kisawp siang hamtang ding hi.
Siampite lak a pasal peuhmah in hih pen ne thei ding hi. Hih pen a siangtho pen ahi hi.
Mawhna hanga biakna sisan Mun Siangtho sungah mawhkhuhna bawl nadingin Kikhopna Puanbuk sungah kipaipih peuhmah lo ding a, zong kine lo ding hi. Tua pen mei sungah kihal tum sitset ding hi.
Hih pen GAMTAT KHIALHNA HANGA BIAKNA ngeina ahi hi; hih pen a siangtho pen ahi hi.
Meihal biakna ganhing amaute in a gawhna mun ah, gamtat khialhna hanga biakna ganhing amaute in go ding uh hi. Siampipa in biaknatau tung kiimkotah a sisan theh ding hi.
Amah in a thaute khempeuh ahi: a meithau, a sungkuate a tuam a thaute,
a kal nihte, a kawngnuai kiim-a om a thaute, a kalte tunga om a sin, a sin tunga a thaute amah in pia ding hi. Hih a kisehsa nate amah in hemkhia ding hi;
Siampipa in Yahweh’ tungah mei tawh kihal biakna-in biaknatau tungah tuate hal ding hi. Hih pen gamtat khialhna hanga biakna khat ahi hi.
Siampite laka pasal peuhmah in hih pen ne thei ding hi. Mun siangtho khat sungah hih pen kine ding hi; hih pen a siangtho pen ahi hi.
Gamtat khialhna hanga biakna pen mawhna hanga biakna tawh kibangin a nih tuak tawh a kisai Thukham/Ngeina khat ahi hi. Tua ganhing tawh mawhkhuhna a bawlsak siampipa in tua biakna sa ngah ding hi.
Mi khatpeuh’ meihal biakna a piaksak siampipa in amah in a piak meihal biakna ganhing’ vun ngah ding hi.
Tua banah, meibung sunga ki-em ahi zongin, sikbeel sunga ahi a, beelpei sunga kihuan ahi zongin an tawh biakna peuhmah tua biakna a pia siampipa in ngah ding hi.
Ahih hangin sathau tawh a kihel ahi a, a keu ahi zongin an tawh biakna peuhmah Aaron’ tapate khempeuh in a kikim ciatin ngah ding uh hi.
Hih pen Yahweh’ tungah amah in a piak KILEMNA BIAKNA-TE biakna’ ngeina ahi hi:

Amah in lungdam kohna hanga biakna a pia ahih leh, hih lungdam kohna biakna tawh amah in sathau tawh kipawi silngo sawh loh anlum mohkeute, sathau kizut silngo sawh loh mohphengte, hoih takin kimekin sathau tawh kipawi annel limci tawh kibawl mohkeute a piakkhop ding ahi hi.
Lungdam koh kilemna ama biakna tawh silngo sawh loh anlum biakna khat a piakkhop ding ahi hi.
Amah in Yahweh’ tungah lamto-a biakpiakna-in nam khat ciat panin khat ta a paipih ding ahi hi. Hih pen kilemna biakna sisan a theh siampipa in ngah ding hi.
Lungdam kohna-in kilemna ama biakna sa pen a kipiak ni mahin kine ding hi. Amah in zingsang dong bangmah siit lo ding hi.

Ahih hangin ama biakpiakna pen KICIAMNA tangtunsakna ahi a, UTTAWMNA HANGA BIAKNA ahi zongin tua biakpiakna pen amah in biakna a piak ni mahin kine ding a, a zingciangin a cianlai teng zong kine thei ding hi;
Hih biakna sa a cianlai-te pen a ni thum ni ciangin mei tawh kihal ding hi.

Kiciamna ahih keileh uttawmna hanga biakna sa khat peuhpeuh a ni thum ni-in a kinek leh, tua biakna pia pa kisang lo ding a, ama a’-in zong kiciamteh lo ding hi. Tua bangin a pia mi peuhmah a kihhuai hi ding a, tua sa a ne mi in a mawhna pua ding hi.
A sianglo na khat peuhpeuh tawh a kisukha sa pen kine lo ding hi; tua pen mei tawh kihal pelmawh ding hi. Adang sa siangte ahih leh, a siang mi khempeuh in ne thei ding hi.
Ahih hangin amah a siang lo a hih sungin Yahweh’ tungah kilemna biakna sa a ne mi, tua mi pen a mipihte kiang panin kibeimangsak ding hi.

Mi khatpeuh in a siang lo na khat peuhpeuh ahi: mihing nitna hitaleh, a siang lo ganhing hitaleh, a siang lo khat peuhpeuh hitaleh a kihhuai na khat hitaleh lawng a, tua khit ciangin Yahweh a’ ahi kilemna biakna sa a nek leh, tua mi pen a mipihte kiang panin kibeimangsak ding hi,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah hopihin, a gen inah:
“Israyl mite kiangah hih bangin gen in, “Note in Yahweh’ tungah meihal biakna-in a kisehsa bawng’ thaute ahi a, tuu’ thau ahi a, keelte’ thau ahi zong tua a thaute khat peuhpeuh na ne kei ding uh hi.
A sisa-a kimu ganhing thau ahih keileh gamsate balgawp ganhing thaute, nadangin kizang thei ding a, ahih hangin tua pen na ne peuhmah kei ding uh hi.
Yahweh’ tungah mei tawh kihal biakna panin ganhing thau a ne mi peuhmah, a mipihte kiang panin kibeimangsak ding hi.
Koikoi ah na teng uh zongin vasate’ sisan ahi a, ganhing’ sisan ahi zongin sisan peuhmah na ne kei ding uh hi.
Sisan khat peuhpeuh a ne mi peuhmah, tua mi a mipihte kiang panin kibeimangsak ding hi,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah hopihin, a gen inah:
“Israyl mite kiangah hih bangin gen in: Yahweh’ tungah kilemna biakna a paipih mi peuhmah in ama biakna Yahweh’ tungah a paipih ding ahi hi;
Ama khut mahmah-in mei tawh kihal biakna Yahweh’ tungah paipih ding hi. Amah in a kisehsa a thau, a awmsa tawh paipih ding a, VEI-A BIAKNA-in Yahweh mai-ah a awmsa a vei ding hi.
Siampipa in biaknatau tungah a thau hal ding a, ahih hangin a awmsa pen Aaron leh a tapate a’ ahi hi.
Tua bek tham loin, kilemna biakna na piak ganhing panin a tak lam phei nangmah in LAMTO-A BIAKNA-in siampipa tungah na pia ding hi.
Aaron’ tapate lak panin khat, kilemna biakna sisan leh a thau a pia pa in ama tanh dingin a taklam phei ngah ding hi.

Keimah in Israyl mite kiang pan leh kilemna amaute’ biakna panin vei-a biakna awmsa leh lamto-a biakna pheisa Ka lakhiakhin a, Israyl mite tung panin a kip tawntung ngeina kip khatin siampi Aaron leh a tapate tungah Ka piakhin hi.
Hih pen, Yahweh’ siampi na a sem dingin amaute a kipiak ni-in, Yahweh tung mei tawh kihal biakna sung panin Aaron leh a tapate tungah a kihawm a kisehtuam, a kisiangsak satanh ahi hi.
Amah in amaute sathau a nilh ni, a khang khangin a kip tawntung ngeina kip khat-in Israyl mite tungtawnin amaute tungah a kipia dingin Yahweh in hih thu pia hi.
Hih pen meihal biakna, an tawh biakna, mawhna hanga biakna, gamtat khialhna hanga biakna, a kisehtuamte, leh kilemna biakpiakna ngeina hi a,
Yahweh in Sinai Sehnel gam sungah Israyl mite in Ama tungah amau’ biakpiaknate a piak nadingin thu a piak ni-in Sinai Mual tungah Yahweh in Mosheh thu a piak ahi hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah hopihin, a gen inah:
“Aaron leh amah tawh a tapate, puante, nilh sathau, mawhna hanga biakna-in bawngtal khat, tuutal nih, silngo kisawh lo anlum lawh khat la inla,
Kikhopna Puanbuk tual lutna ah mihon khempeuh kaikhawm in,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh a thupiak bangin Mosheh gamta-in Kikhopna Puanbuk tual lutna ah mihon khempeuh a kaikhawm hi.
Tua khit ciangin Mosheh in mihonpite kiangah, “Hih pen Yahweh in hih dingin a thupiak ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin Mosheh in Aaron leh a tapate a mai lamah paipihin, kisilna kuang panin tui tawh amaute a sil hi.

Amah in Aaron tungah puantungsilh silhsak a, kawnggakna tawh amah vialin, puantualpi silhsak a, ama tungah siampipuan a silhsak hi. Amah in hoih takin a kigan kawnggak tawh ama tungah siampipuan zong a gak hi; tua ahih manin ama tungah tua pen kikhih kip hi.
Amah in Aaron tungah awmdal bulhin, a awmdal sungah Urim leh Thummim a koih hi.
Amah in a lu tungah dialkhip; mitznepheth, koih hi. Yahweh in a thupiaksa mah bangin tua dialkhip; mitznepheth, mai-ah amah in kham peek, kumpi lukhu siangtho khusak hi.
Tua khit ciangin Mosheh in nilh sathau la-in, biakbuk leh tua sunga om a vanzatte khempeuh sathau nilhin, tua ciangin amaute sehtuamin a siangthosak hi.
Amah in biaknatau tungah a sisan tawmkhat sagih vei thehin, tuate a sehtuam ding leh a siangthosak dingin biaknatau leh a vanzatte khempeuh, kisil nadinga kuang leh a tunna sathau nilh hi.
Amah in Aaron’ lu tungah nilh sathau tawmkhat sungsuk a, amah sathau nilhin sehtuamin a siangthosak hi.

Tua khit ciangin Mosheh in Aaron’ tapate paipihin, Yahweh in Mosheh a thupiaksa mah bangin amaute tungah puantungsilhte silhsakin, kawnggakna tawh amah vialin, amaute tungah lukhu neu; migbaoth, a khusak hi.
Mosheh in mawhna hanga biakna dingin bawngtal paipih hi. Tua ciangin Aaron leh a tapate in mawhna hanga biakna bawngtal lu tungah a khutte uh nga-in,

tua ciangin Mosheh in a go hi. Tua khit ciangin amah in a sisan la-in, biaknatau a siangsak dingin biaknatau kiimkot khempeuh-a a kite tungah a khutme tawh sisan tawmkhat a zut hi. Tua ciangin amah in sehtuamin siangthosak a, tua aa dingin mawhkhuhna a bawlsak hi.
Tua khit ciangin amah in bawngtal’ sungkuate tunga a thau khempeuh, a sin tung a tuam a thau, a kal nihte leh a thaute la-in, Mosheh in biaknatau tungah a hal hi.
Ahih hangin Yahweh in Mosheh a thupiaksa bangin giahphual pualam mun siangtho sung khatah bawngtal’ vun, a satak, leh a ekte, amah in mei tawh a hal hi.
Tua ciangin amah in meihal biakna tuutalte lak panin khat la a, Aaron leh a tapate in tuutal’ lu tungah a khutte uh nga-in,
Mosheh in a go hi. Tua khit ciangin amah in biaknatau tung kiimkotah a sisan theh hi.
Amah in tuutal semnen hi; Mosheh in a lu, a kisemnente, leh a thaute hal a,

a sungkuate leh a khete tui sungah sawp masa-in biaknatau tungah tuutal buppi a hal hi. Tua pen, Yahweh in Mosheh a thupiaksa bangin Yahweh’ tungah mei tawh kihal biakna a lungkimhuai gim namtui dingin meihal biakna khat ahi hi.
Tua khit ciangin amah in sehtuam tuutal ahi a nihna tuutal paipih hi. Tua ciangin Aaron leh a tapate in hih tuutal’ lu tungah a khutte nga ding uh a,
tua khit ciangin Mosheh in go hi. Amah in a sisan tawmkhat la-in, Aaron’ taklam bilteep dawn, a taklam khutpi tung, leh a taklam khepi tungah zut hi.

Tua tak ciangin amah in Aaron’ tapate paipihin, Mosheh in amau’ bilteepte tung, amau’ taklam khutpite tung, leh amau’ taklam khepite tungah a sisan tawmkhat zut ding hi. Tua khit ciangin Mosheh in biaknatau tung kiimkotah a sisan theh hi.
Tua khit ciangin amah in a nihna tuutal panin a thau leh a meithau, a sungkuate panin a thau khempeuh, a sin a tuam a thaute, a kalnihte leh a kal’ tunga a thaute, leh a taklam phei la hi;

Yahweh mai-a silngo sawh loh anlum lawh sung panin, amah in anlum mohkeu khat, sathau tawh a kibawl khat, mohpheng khat la hi. Amah in sehtanh sathaute tung leh a taklam phei tungah amah in hihte a koih hi.
Amah in hihte khempeuh Aaron leh a tapate’ khut sungah koih a, Yahweh mai-ah vei-a biakna-in tuate a vei hi.

Tua khit ciangin Mosheh in amau’ khutte panin tuate la-in meihal biaknatau tungah koihin biaknatau tungah tuate a hal hi. Yahweh’ tungah mei tawh kihal biakna a lungkimhuai gim namtui dingin tuate pen sehtuam biakpiakna ahi hi.
Tua khit ciangin Mosheh in a awmsa la-in, Yahweh mai-ah vei-a biakna-in a vei hi. Yahweh in Mosheh a thupiaksa bangin hih pen Mosheh’ sehtuam tuutal satanh ahi hi.

Tua tak ciangin Mosheh in nilh sathau tawmkhat leh biaknatau panin sisan tawmkhat la-in, Aaron tung, ama puante tung leh a tapate tung, leh amau’ puante tungah a theh hi. Tua ciangin amah in Aaron leh a puante, leh a tapate leh amau’ puante sehtuamin a siangthosak hi.

Mosheh in Aaron leh a tapate kiangah, “Kikhopna Puanbuk lama lutna ah a satak huan unla, keimah in, ‘Aaron leh a tapate in ne thei ding hi,’ ci-in ka thupiak mah bangin sehtuam biakna panin lawh sunga anlum tawh tua lai munah na ne ding uh hi.
A sa leh anlum a cianlai peuhmah, note in mei tawh na hal ding uh hi.
Note hong kisehtuam hun leh hong kikipsak hun a bei matengin note in ni sagih sung Kikhopna Puanbuk lama lutna na nusia kei ding uh hi. Note sehtuamna pen ni sagih sung ahi ding hi.
Yahweh in tu ni-in a hihsa peuhmah, note aa dingin mawhkhuhna a bawlsak dingin Yahweh in thupiakhin hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Kikhopna Puanbuk lama lutna ah sun leh zan ni sagih sung note na om pelmawh ding uh a, Yahweh’ na na sem gige ding uh hi; tua ahih leh note na si kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh tua pen keima tungah thu hong kipiakhin hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Aaron leh a tapate in Mosheh tungtawnin a thupiaksa nate khempeuh a hih uh hi.
A ni giat ni-in Mosheh in Aaron leh a tapate, leh Israyl upate samsak hi.
Amah in Aaron kiangah, “Nang mahmah aa ding mawhna hanga biakna bawngtal khanglai khat leh meihal biakna tuutal khat, a nih tuakin a sitbaang lo la inla, Yahweh mai-ah tuate pia in.
Tua khit ciangin nangmah in Israyl mite kiangah, ‘Mawhna hanga biakna-in keel a pa khat leh meihal biakna-in bawngno khat, leh tuuno khat, a nih tuakin kum khat a phaleh a sitbaang lo,

tua banah Yahweh mai-ah a kipia dingin kilemna biakna-in bawngtal khat leh tuutal khat, sathau tawh a kipawi an tawh biakna la un; bang hang hiam cihleh tuni-in note’ tungah Yahweh hong kilang ding hi,’ ci-in gen in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin amaute in Kikhopna Puanbuk mai-ah Mosheh thupiaksa peuhmah paipih uh hi; mihon khempeuh a nai-ah hong pai-in Yahweh mai-ah a ding uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin Mosheh in, “Hih pen Yahweh in note hih dingin a thupiak na ahi hi, tua ahih manin Yahweh’ minthanna vang note tungah hong kilang ding hi,” a ci hi.

Mosheh in Aaron kiangah, “Biaknatau ah pai inla, na mawhna hanga biakna leh na meihal biakna pia inla, nang mahmah aa ding leh na mite aa dingin mawhkhuhna bawl in; Yahweh in a thupiak bangin na mite aa dingin biakpiakna paipih inla, amaute aa dingin mawhkhuhna bawlsak in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin biaknatau ah Aaron pai a, ama aa dingin mawhna hanga biakna bawngno khat a go hi.
Tua khit ciangin Aaron’ tapate in ama kiangah a sisan hong paipih uh a, a sisan sungah amah in a khutme diahsukin biaknatau kite tungah zut a, a vallai sisan teng biaknatau phungah a sungsuk hi.
Ahih hangin a thaute, a kalte, mawhna hanga biakna sa sin panin a thaute, Yahweh in Mosheh a thupiaksa bangin amah in biaknatau tungah hal hi.
A satak leh a vun amah in giahphual pua lamah mei tawh hal hi.
Tua khit ciangin amah in meihal biakna ganhing go a, Aaron’ tapate in ama kiangah a sisan hong paipihin, amah in biaknatau tung kiimkotah tua pen a theh hi.
Tua khit ciangin amaute in ama kiangah meihal biakna ganhing, a kisemnente leh a lu tawh hong paipih uh a, amah in biaknatau tungah tuate a hal hi.
A sungkuate leh a khete sawp masa-in tua khit ciangin biaknatau tungah tuate a haltum hi.
Tua khit ciangin amah in mite aa dingin mawhna hanga biakna ganhing ahi amaute mawhna hanga biakna keel paipih a, a masa mah bangin a go hi.
Tua khit ciangin amah in meihal biakna paipih a, ngeina kip omsa tawh kizui-in a pia hi.
Tua khit ciangin amah in an tawh biakna paipih a, zingsang meihal biakna banah tua panin khut dim khat la-in biaknatau tungah a hal hi.
Amah in mite aa ding kilemna biakna-in bawngtal leh tuutal go hi. Tua khit ciangin Aaron’ tapate in ama kiangah a sisan paipih uh a, amah in biaknatau tung kiimkotah tua sisan a theh hi.
Bawngtal tung pan leh tuutal tung pana a thaute, a meithau, a sungkuate leh a kalte a tuam a thaute, a kal nihte, leh a sin a tuam a thaute,
amaute in hih a thaute a awmsa tungah koih uh hi; tua khit ciangin amah in biaknatau tungah a thaute a hal hi;
Ahih hangin a awmsa leh a taklam phei pen Mosheh in thu a piaksa bangin Yahweh mai-ah vei-a biakna-in amah in vei hi.
Tua khit ciangin Aaron in mite lamah a khut lamto-in amaute thupha a pia hi. Mawhna hanga biakna, meihal biakna, kilemna biakna a nei-in amah hong paisuk hi.

Tua khit ciangin Kikhopna Puanbuk sungah Mosheh leh Aaron lut uh hi. Amaute hong paikhiat uh ciangin, amaute in mite thupha a pia uh hi. Tua khit ciangin Yahweh’ minthanna vang mi khempeuh tungah kilang a,
Yahweh Omna panin meikuang hong pusuakin, meihal biakpiakna leh biaknatau tunga sathaute a kangtum hi.

Aaron’ tapate ahi Nadab leh Abihu, amau’ paknamtui beel tuak la-in a sungah mei koih uh a, a tungah paknamtui koihin, Ama Thukham; ngeina, tawh kileh bulhin phalna ngah lo pi-in Yahweh mai-ah zahtak loin mei a hal uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahweh kiang panin mei hong pusuakin, amaute kangtum hi; tua ahih manin Yahweh mai-ah amaute a si uh hi.

Tua ciangin Mosheh in Aaron kiangah, “Hih pen Yahweh in, ‘Ka kiang hong nai mite lakah Keimah a siangtho ka hi taktak a, Siangtho-in ka kilang a, mi khempeuh mai-ah kei hong kiminthangsak ding hi,’ ci-in a gen ahi hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Aaron daitakin om hi.

Tua khit ciangin Aaron’ pa sanggampa Uzziel’ tapate ahi Mishael leh Elzaphan samin amaute kiangah, “Hong pai unla, munsiangtho mai panin a kigamlatna giahphual pua lamah na sanggamte uh hong puakhia un,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin amaute hong pai uh a, Mosheh in a gensa bangin puantungsilhte tawh giahphual pualam ah a puakhia uh hi.

Mosheh in Aaron leh a tapate ahi Eleazar leh Ithamar kiangah, “Na sam uh sausak kei unla, na puante uh zong kikeeksak kei un, tua bang ahih kei leh na si ding uh hi; mihon buppi tungah Yahweh hong heh ding hi. Ahih hangin na sanggamte ahi Israyl innkuan buppi, Yahweh in mei tawh a suksiat mite na kah thei ding uh hi.

Note pen Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna panin na paikhia kei ding uh hi, tua bang ahih keileh na si ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh’ nilh sathau note tungah om hi. Tua ahih manin Mosheh gen bangin amaute a gamta uh hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in Aaron kiangah hopihin a gen inah:

“Nang hitaleh nang tawh a om na tapate hitaleh Kikhopna Puanbuk sung na lut uh ciangin leenggah zu ahi a, kham theih zu ahi zongin ne kei un, tua bang ahih keileh na si ding uh hi. Hih pen a khang khangin a kip tawntung ngeina kip khat ahi ding hi.
Nangmah in a siangtho leh a siangtho lo, a nin leh a siang na khentel ding a,
Mosheh tungtawnin Yahweh in amaute tunga a gensa ngeina khempeuh Israyl mite na hilh pelmawh ding hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Mosheh in Aaron leh a om lai a tapate ahi Eleazar leh Ithamar-te kiangah, “Yahweh’ tungah mei tawh kihal biakna a cianlai an tawh biaknate la unla, biaknatau gei-ah silngo lo tawh ne un; bang hang hiam cihleh hih pen a siangtho pen ahi hi.
Note in mun siangtho ah tua pen na ne ding uh hi, bang hang hiam cihleh hih pen Yahweh’ tungah mei tawh kihal biakna nangma tanh leh na tapate’ tanh ahi hi. Ahang in keimah thu hong kipiakhin hi.

Vei-a biakna awmsa leh lamto-a biakna pheisa a siang mun ah nang, na tapate, leh nang tawh a om na tanute tawh na ne thei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Israyl mite kiang panin kilemna biakna panin a kipia nangma tanh leh na tapate tanh ahi hi.

Lamto-a biakna pheisa leh vei-a biakna awmsa pen Yahweh mai-ah vei-a biakna-in biakna a pia dingin mei tawh kihal sathau biaknate tawh amaute in hong paipih ding uh hi. Yahweh in a thupiaksa bangin tawntung ngeina kip khatin tua pen nang leh nang tawh a om na tapate a’ ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Mosheh in mawhna hanga biakna keel tawh kisai thu limtakin kan a, a kihaltum khit lam a mu ciangin Aaron’ tapa omlaite tungah amah hehin, gen a,

“Mun siangtho sungah mawhna hanga biakna sa bang hangin ne lo na hi uh hiam? Hih pen a siangtho pen hi a, Yahweh mai-ah amaute aa dingin mawhkhuhna bawlsakna tawh mi honpi khialhna lakkhiatna dingin Yahweh in note tungah hong piaksa ahi hi.
Mun Siangtho sungah a sisan a kipaipih loh nung sang, keima kong thupiaksa bangin munsiangtho huam sungah tua keel na nek ding ahi hi,” a ci hi.

Tua tak ciangin Aaron in Mosheh kiangah, “Tuni-in amaute in Yahweh mai-ah amau mawhna hanga biakna leh amau meihal biakna piakhin ta uh hi; ahih hangin tua bang nate kei tungah hong piang hi! Keimah in tuni-in tua mawhna hanga biakna sa a na nekhin hi leng, Yahweh’ muhna tua pen a kisangthei hi ding ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Mosheh in hih thu a zak ciangin, amah a lungkim hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh leh Aaron kiangah hopihin, amaute tungah a gen inah:
“Israyl mite tungah hih bangin gen un: Hihte pen leitung a om ganhing khempeuh lak panin na nek theih ding uh ganhingte ahi hi:
Ganhingte lak panin a khecin a ka, eknel a hai peuhmah note in na ne thei ding uh hi.

Tua bang ahih hangin pawlkhat in eknel bek khai-in ahih keileh a khecin bek a ka ganhingte, note in na ne peuhmah kei ding uh hi: Kalaoh in eknel a khai hangin a khecin ka lo ahih manin note aa dingin a nin ahi hi.
Sakikh ganhing in eknel a hai hangin khecin ka lo ahih manin note aa dingin a nin ahi hi;
Bilpi in eknel a hai hangin a khecin ka lo ahih ciangin note aa dingin a nin ahi hi.
Vok pen a khecin a kat hangin eknel khai lo ahih manin note aa dingin a nin ahi hi.
Tuate’ sa note in na ne kei ding uh a, a sisate zong na lawng kei ding uh hi. Tuate pen note aa dingin a nin ahi hi.
Tuite sunga om khempeuh panin note nek theih dingte pen: tuite sunga phe leh lip a nih tuakin a nei peuhmah, tuipi sung ahi a, gunte sunga om ahi zongin, tuate pen note in na ne thei ding uh hi.

Ahih hangin tuipi sunga om ahi a, gunte sunga om ahi zongin a honvak nga khempeuh lak panin hitaleh tui sunga adang nuntakna a nei ganhingte khempeuh pan hitaleh lip leh phe a nihtuakin a nei lo peuhmah pen a kihhuai ahi hi;
tuate pen note aa dingin a kihhuai ahi hi. Tuate sa note in na ne kei ding uh a, a sisate zong na kih ding uh hi.
Tuite sunga om phe leh lip a nih tuakin a nei lo peuhmah note aa dingin a kihhuai a hi hi.
Vasate lak panin note aa dingin a kihhuai-in na ciapteh uh hihte na ne kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh tuate pen kihhuai hi: Muvanlai, mupi, luimu,
mumeika, musan nam khempeuh;
va-ak nam khempeuh,
vasa-kalaoh, pengpelep, vatawt, musi nam khempeuh,
keising, tuimu, gun vakang,
gam vatawt, tui vatawt, musane,
gun vapi, gun vazonei nam khempeuh, huihtun, leh bak ahi hi.
Hih a leng thei khe li tawh a pai ganhing peuhmah note aa dingin a kihhuai ahi hi.
Ahi zongin khe li tawh a pai, kha a nei ganhingte khempeuh lak panin leitungah a tuan nadingun a khepek uh tawh kizom ngaltak tawn a neite na ne thei ding uh hi.
Note nek theih dingte pen: Kauphe kitom nam khempeuh, kauphe zol nam khempeuh, khuangbai nam khempeuh leh kauphe kisau nam khempeuh ahi hi.
Ahih hangin leng thei-in khe li a nei ganhing dangte khempeuh note aa dingin a kihhuai ahi hi;
Hihte tawh note a nin na suak ding uh a, tuate a sisa khatpeuh a lawng mi peuhmah ni a tum mateng a nin hi ding hi;
A sisa khatpeuh a tawm peuhmah in a puante sawp pelmawh ding a, ni tum matengin a nin hi ding hi;
A khecin a kat hangin eknel a hai lo ganhing peuhmah’ luang pen note aa dingin a nin ahi hi; tua luang a lawng peuhpeuh a nin ahi ding hi.
Khe li tawh a pai ganhingte khempeuh lak panin amau’ khebom tawh a paite khempeuh note aa dingin a nin ahi hi; tua bangin a sisa khatpeuh a lawng peuhmah ni tum mateng a nin ding hi.
Tua a sisate a tawm khatpeuh in a puansilhte sawp pelmawh ding a, ni tum mateng a nin hi-in, note aa dingin a nin a hi hi.
Leilak-a a kikhin litlit ganhingte panin hihte pen note aa dingin a nin ahi hi: bui, zusa, leh innhikpi nam khempeuh,
tawlbawkpi, tang, tangteuh, leh sehnel gam thankik ahi hi.
Hihte pen leilak-a a kikhin litlit khempeuh lak panin note’ tungah a nin ahi hi. Tuate a sih ciangin a lawng peuhmah, nitak matengin a nin hi ding hi.

Tuate khatpeuh a sih ciangin khatpeuh tung, van tung, nazatte tung, sing nazat tung, puansilhte tung, savun tung, ippi leh na khat peuhpeuhin a kizang beel khat peuhpeuh tungah a tuk ciangin a nin hi ding a, tui sungah kidiah pelmawh ding hi. Tua pen ni tum matengin a nin hi ding a, tua khit ciangin a siang hi ding hi.
Tuate khatpeuh lei beel sungah a kiat leh, tua lei beel kisutam hamtang ding hi; tua beel sunga a om peuhpeuh a nin hi ding hi:
Tua bang beel sunga om a kine thei ding an tungah tua bang tui a tuk leh a nin hi ding hi. Tua beel sung pan a kidawn thei a tui peuhmah a nin ahi hi.
Tua bang a sisa themkhat a tukna peuhmah a nin hi ding hi; Meibung hitaleh beelpei hitaleh kisuzan pelmawh ding hi. Tuate a ninsuak a, note aa dingin a nin hi ding hi.
Ahi zongin tuinak leh tuibeel ahihleh a siang hi ding a, ahih hangin a sisate a lawng peuhmah a ninsuak ding hi.
A kivawh ding khaici tungah a sisa khat peuh a tuk leh, tua pen a siang hi ding hi.
Ahih hangin khaici tui kibuak khinin, tua ciangin a sisa khatpeuh tua tungah a tuk leh; tua tak ciangin tua pen note aa dingin a nin ahi hi.
Note’ nek theih ganhing khatpeuh a sih leh, tua a si ganhing a lawng mipa ni tum mateng a nin hi ding hi;
Tua a si ganhing a ne peuhmah in a puansilhte sawp ding a, ni tum mateng a nin hi ding hi. Tua a si ganhing a tawi mipa in a puansilhte sawp ding a, ni tum mateng a nin hi ding hi.
Leitung ah a kikhin litlit nuntakna a nei ganhing peuhmah, tangtel namte, toktolte, tengkolte, sumkuangte, thankikte, uiphukte, leh gulte pen a kihhuai ahi hi. Hihte pen kine lo ding hi;

A awmtal peuhmah leh khe li khempeuh tawh a pai peuhmah ahi a, leilak-a a gamtang khempeuh lak panin khe tampi-in a pai ahi zongin note in na ne kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh tuate pen a kihhuai ahi hi.
Leilak-a a gamtang ganhing khat peuhpeuh tawh no-le-no a kihhuai-in na kibawl kei ding uh hi. Tuate hangin nang-le-nang kininsak kei inla, tuate hangin a nin-in kibawltawm kei in.

Keimah Yahweh note Vantung Pa ka hi hi. Nomau mah tua ahih ciangin kisehtuam-in, kisiangsak unla, Keimah siangtho Ka hih manin note zong na siangtho ding uh hi. Leilak-a a gamtang ganhing khat peuhpeuh tawh nomau mah na kininsak tawm kei ding uh hi.
Note Vantung Pa ahi dingin Egypt gam panin hong paikhiatpih Keimah Yahweh ka hi hi. Keimah siangtho ka hih manin note zong a siangtho na hi ding uh hi.
Hih pen ganhingte, vasate leh tuite sunga a gamtang nuntakna a nei khempeuh, leh leilak-a a gamtang ganhing khempeuh tawh kisai Thukham ahi hi.
Nangmah in a nin leh a siang, a kine thei ganhing leh a kine lo ding ganhing na khentel sitset ding hi,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah hopihin, a gen inah:
“Israyl mite kiangah hih bangin gen in: Nupi khatpeuh gai-in, ta pasal a neih leh, tua ciangin tua numei ni sagih sung a nin hi ding hi; a khasim nin neih hunte mah bangin amah a nin hi ding hi.
A ni giat ni-in naungek vundawn ki-at ding hi.

Tua ciangin nupi in ama si luanna hangin a sian nadingin ni 33 om beh lai ding hi. Tua nu a kisiansakna nite a bei mateng; a vek-a kigawm ni 40, tua nu in a siang na; qodesh, khatpeuh lawng lo ding a, sehtuam mun khatpeuh; miqqedash, sungah zong lut lo ding hi.

Ahih hangin amah in ta numei khat a neih leh, ama nin neih huna mah bangin kalnih sung; ni 14, a nin hi ding hi; Ama si luanna hangin a sian nadingin ni 66 om beh lai ding hi; a veka kigawm ni 80 ahi hi.

Ama kisiansakna nite a bei ciangin, a tapa aa ding ahi a, a tanu aa dingin ahi zongin, meihal biakna-in kum khat a pha tuuno khat, mawhna hanga biakna-in vakhuno khat ahih keileh kawl vakhuno khat siampipa kiang Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna ah paipih ding hi.

Tua khit ciangin amah siampipa in tua numei aa dingin mawhkhuhna a bawl dingin Yahweh mai-ah biakna pia ding a, tua khit ciangin ama sisan luanna panin amah a siang hi ding hi. Hih pen ta pasal hitaleh ta numei hitaleh a nei nu aa dingin Thukham; ngeina ahi hi.

Tua nu in tuuno a neih zawh keileh vakhu nih ahi a, kawl vakhuno nih ahi zongin paipih ding hi; khat pen meihal biakna-in a khat pen mawhna hanga biakna hi ding hi. Hih bang danin siampipa in tua nu aa dingin mawhkhuhna bawlsak ding a, tua nu a siang hi ding hi,” a ci hi.

headings.text: Phak bangin Vun tung Natna tawh Kisai

verses.text: Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah hopihin, a gen inah:

“Mi khat in ama pumpi vun tungah a bawk ahi a, meima ahi a, a mel tuampian ahi zongin a neih a, tua pen ama pumpi vun tungah phaknatna bangin a kilawh thei vun natna khatpeuh a suah leh, tua ciangin siampi Aaron kiang ahi a, siampite ahi a tapate khatpeuh kiangah ahi zongin amah kipaipih ding hi.

Siampipa in ama pumpi vun tunga tua natna mun veel ding hi; A natna mun-a a om a multe kangin ama vun sangin a natna thuktum zaw-in a kimuh leh, tua pen a kilawh thei vun natna khat ahi hi. Siampipa in a veel khit ciangin amah a siang lo hi, ci-in pulaak ding hi.
A vun tunga a natna mun kangin ahih hangin a vun sangin a thuktum zaw loin, tua mun-a a multe a kangin a kikhel keileh, siampipa in ni sagih sung cina pa mun khat ah tuamkoih ding hi.
A ni sagih ni-in siampipa in amah veel ding a, amah in tua natna kilamdanna nei lo-in, a vun sungah zong a lawh kei leh, amah in adang ni sagih sungmah tuamkoih lai ding hi.

A zom ni sagih kik ciangin siampipa in amah veel leuleu ding a, a natna mun mualin, a vun sung a lawh kei leh, siampipa in siang hi, ci-in pulaak ding hi; tua pen meima mawkmawk hi lel hi. Tua mipa in a puansilhte sawp ding a, amah a siang hi ding hi.
Ahih hangin siampipa tungah amah siang hi ci-in a kilak khit ciangin a meima in a vun sung a lawh leh siampipa mai-ah kilakkik ding hi.
Siampipa in amah veel ding a, a vun sungah a meima a lawh leh, amah a siang lo hi, ci-in siampipa in pulaak ding hi; tua pen a kilawh thei vun natna ahi hi.
Mi khatpeuh in a kilawh thei vun natna a neih ciangin, siampipa kiangah amah kipaipih ding hi.
Siampipa in amah veel ding a, a vun sungah a bawk kang khat omin, tua in a multe kangsakin a abawk sungah ma thak a om leh,

tua pen a om kikkik vun natna khat hi a, amah a siang lo hi, ci-in siampipa in pulaak ding hi. Siampipa in mun khat ah amah tuamkoih ding hi, bang hang hiam cihleh amah a siang lo hi, kici khin a, dawt nang thu om lo hi.
Tua natna a vun tung khempeuh ah phukhamin, a na mi’ vun khempeuh natna in tuamin, lu panin a khe dong siampipa muhna mun khempeuh a lawh leh,
siampipa in veel ding a, a natna in a pumpi khempeuh a lawh khit leh siampipa in tua natna tawh kisai-in amah siang hi, ci-in gen ding hi. A pumpi-in kangkhin ahih nung sang amah a siang hi a,
ahih hangin ama tungah ma thak a kilat ciangin amah a nin hi ding hi.
Siampipa in a ma thak a veel ciangin, amah a siang lo hi, ci-in pulaak ding hi. A ma thak pen a nin ahi hi; amah in a kilawh thei natna nei ahi hi.
A ma thak hong kikhelin, tua khit ciangin a kang a suah leh, siampipa kiangah amah pai hamtang ding hi.
Siampipa in amah veel ding a, tua natna a kangin a kikhel khit leh, a na mi siang hi ci-in siampipa in pulaak ding hi. Amah a siang ahi hi.
Mi khatpeuh in ama vun tungah meima tum khat a nei-in, meima tum dam a,
tua meima tum omna mun bawkin kanga ahih keileh a san-kang teptap a suah leh, siampipa kiangah amah kilak hamtang ding hi.

Siampipa in tua pen veel ding a, tua pen a vun sangin thuktum zaw-in a multe a kangin a kikhelkhit leh, siampipa in amah a siang lo hi, ci-in pulaak ding hi. Hih pen meima tum omna panin hong phukhia a kilawh thei vun natna ahi hi.
Ahih hangin siampipa in veelin, tua lai munah a mul kang om loin, a vun sangin thuktum zaw loin, a mualhkhit leh, tua ciangin siampipa in ni sagih sung mun khat ah amah tuamkoih ding hi.
Tua in a vun tung khempeuh ah kizelh leh, tua ciangin siampipa in amah a siang lo hi, ci-in pulaak ding hi. Hih pen a kilawh thei vun natna khat ahi hi.
Ahih hangin a natna pen kilamdanna nei lo-in koimah a lawh kei leh, tua pen meima tum panin a pawn hi lel a, siampipa in amah siang hi ci-in pulaak ding hi.
Mi khatpeuh in a vun tungah meikangma khat nei-in, tua meikangma a thak mun pen a san-kang ahi a, a kang ahi zongin hong suah leh,,

Siampipa in a natna mun veel ding a, tua muna om a multe kangin, a vun sangin a thuktum zawk leh, tua pen meikangma panin hong phukhia a kilawh thei natna ahi hi. Amah siang lo hi, ci-in siampipa in pulaak ding hi; tua pen a kilawh thei vun natna khat ahi hi.
Ahih hangin siampipa in tua pen veelin, a mun-a a multe kang lo-in, a vun sangin thuktum zaw loin, a mualhkhit leh, tua ciangin siampipa in ni sagih sung mun khat ah tuamkoih ding hi.
A ni sagih ni-in siampipa in amah veel leuleu ding a, tua in a vun sung a lawh leh, amah a siang lo hi, ci-in siampipa in pulaak ding hi. Tua pen a kilawh thei vun natna khat ahi hi.

Ahih hangin a natna mun pen mun kilamdanna om loin, a vun sungah kilawh loin, ahih hangin a mualhkhit leh, tua pen meikatna panin a bawl hi a, amah siang hi ci-in siampipa in pulaak ding hi. Tua pen meikatna panin a pawn hi lel a, a kilawh thei hi lo hi.
Pasal ahi a, numei ahi zongin a lutang tungah; a sam omna mun, ahih keileh a kha; a khamul pona mun, ah meima khatpeuh a neih leh,

siampipa in tua meima veel ding a, a vun sangin thuktum zaw-in, a sunga a multe naipak-in a mal a neu leh, siampipa in tua mi a siang lo hi, ci-in pulaak ding hi. Tua pen lu tung ahi a, kha ah ahi zongin a kilawh thei cithak natna khat ahi hi.
Ahih hangin siampipa in tua natna veel ciangin, a vun sangin a thuktum lo zaw tawh kibangin, sam vom a om kei leh, tua ciangin siampipa in ni sagih sung mun khatah a na mi tuamkoih ding hi.
A ni sagih ni-in siampipa in tua natna veelkik ding a, tua cithak a kizelh kei a, tua sungah sam naipak om loin, a vun sangin thuktum zaw-in a kilat kei leh,
tua ciangin amah in a natna mun losiah a mul kiat ding a, siampipa in ni sagih sung mun tuam khat ah amah keem ding hi.

A ni sagih ni-in siampipa in tua cithak veelkik leuleu ding a, a vun sungah kilawh loin, a vun sangin a thuktum lo zaw-in a kilat leh, siampipa in amah a siang hi, ci-in tang ko ding hi. Amah in a puansilhte sawpin, amah a siang hi ding hi.
Ahih hangin amah siang hi, ci-in a kipulaak khit ciangin a vun sungah a cithak a kilawh leh,
siampipa in amah veelkik ding hi. Tua cithak a vun sungah a kilawhkhit leh, siampipa in a mul a naipak hiam ci-in etkul lo hi, dot nang thu omlo hi: tua mi a siang lo ahi hi.
Ahih hangin kilamdanna om loin, a natna sungah mul vom a pokhin hi ci-in a khentel leh, a cithak a damkhin hi. Amah a siang hi a, siampipa in amah siang hi, ci-in pulaak ding hi.
Pasal ahi a, numei ahi zongin a vun tungah a kang mun a neih ciangin,
Siampipa in amaute veel ding hi. Tua munte pen a kang milmial ahih leh, tua pen a lauhuai lo a vun tung panin a phukhia-in a dulh hi a, tua mi a siang ahi hi.
Pasal khatpeuh a sam pulhin a lu a tol leh, amah a siang ahi hi.
Ama luzang panin a sam pulhin a tal a kolh leh, amah a siang ahi hi.
Ahih hangin a lutol tung ahi a, a talkolhna tungah ahi zongin a san-kang meima a om leh, tua pen a lutol tungah ahih kei leh a talkolh tunga a suakkhia a kilawh thei natna khat ahi hi.
Siampipa in amah veel ding a, a lutang tungah ahi a, a taltang tungah ahi zongin meima bawk pen a kilawh thei vun natna tawh kibangin a san-kangin a om leh,
tua mipa natna vei hi a, a siang lo ahi hi. A lu tunga a om meima hangin siampipa in amah a siang lo hi, ci-in pulaak ding hi.
Tua banga a kilawh thei natna a nei mi in pel loin puansilh a kekte silhin, a lu tuam loin, a maitang a nuailam tuam ding a, ‘A Siang lo! A Siang lo!’ ci-in awngkhia ding hi.
Tua natna a vei sung tawntung amah a siang lo hi ding hi. Amah a siang lo ahih manin amah bek teng ding hi. Giahphual pualam ah amah om hamtang ding hi.
Samul puan hitaleh saihadial puan hitaleh puansilh khatpeuh ap-in a nitsak leh,
A kigan ahi a, saihadial puan a kiphan nate a hi a, samul ahi a, savun ahi a, savun khat peuhpeuh tawh a kibawl ahi a,

puansilh a hi a, savun ahi a, a kigan ahi a, a kiphan nate ahi a, savun van khat peuhpeuh a mel eng pian ahih keileh san pian leh, tua pen a ap khat a bang hi a, siampipa kiangah kilak hamtang ding hi.
Siampipa in tua a ap pen veel ding a, tua a ap na pen ni sagih sung tuamkoih ding hi.

A ni sagih ni-in amah in veelkik ding a, tua a ap pen puansilh tungah ahi a, a kigan ahi a, a kiphan nate ahi a, savun tungah ahi a, a kizang van peuhpeuh tunga ahi zongin a mundang a lawh leh, tua pen a siahuai a ap khat hi a; tua na pen a siang lo ahi hi.

Amah in puansilh ahi a, a kigan ahi a, samul ahih keileh saihadial puan kiphan ahi a, savun na khat peuhpeuh ahi zongin tua tunga a nin a bang peuhmah haltum hamtang ding hi. Tua a ap pen a siahuai ahi hi; tua na kihaltum hamtang ding hi.
Ahih hangin siampipa in tua pen a veel ciangin tua a ap pen puansilh tung ahi a, a kigan ahi a, a kiphan na ahi a, savun van tungah ahi zongin mundang a lawh keileh,
Amah in tua a ap na pen a kisawp dingin amah in thu pia ding a, amah in adang ni sagih sung mah tua na tuamkoih ding hi.

Tua a apna mun a kisawp khit, ni sagih a bei khit ciangin siampipa in veelkik ding hi. A ap pen a melpuakzia kikhel loin, mundang a lawh loh hangin, tua pen a siang lo ahi hi. A ap in a pang lang khat ahi a, adang khat bek a siatsak ahih hangin mei tawh na hal ding hi.

Ahih hangin siampipa in tua pen a veel ciangin, tua a kisawp khit nungin a ap pen a mualh leh, amah in puansilh panin ahi a, a kigan ahi a, a kiphan na ahi a, savun pan ahi zongin a siatna mun teng balkhia ding hi.
Ahih hangin puansilh tung ahi a, a kigan ahi a, a kiphan na ahi a, savun van tungah ahi zongin a hong kilatkik leh, tua pen a kizel hi a, a ap a nei bangbang pen mei tawh na hal hamtang ding uh hi.
A kisawp khinsa leh a ap a paikhiatna puansilh ahi a, a kigan ahi a, a kiphan na ahi a, savun van khat peuhpeuh ahi zongin kisawpkik hamtang ding a, tua ciangin a siang ahi ding hi.

Hih pen samul puan hitaleh saihadial puan hitaleh, a kigan hitaleh, a kiphan na hitaleh na khat peuhpeuh aa dinga a kizang savun khat peuhpeuh tungah a om ap tawh a ninsak thei na tawh kisai-in a siang leh a siang lo pulaak nadingin Thukham; ngeina, ahi hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah hopihin, a gen inah:
“Hih pen siampipa kiangah amah a kipaipih ciangin amah a kisiansak ni-in mi phak leh a na mi aa dingin Thukham; ngeina, ahi ding hi:
siampipa giahphual pualam ah paikhia masa ding a, amah veel ding hi. Tua mi a phaknatna ahih keileh a kilawh thei vun natna panin a damkhit leh,
a kisiangsak ding mipa aa dingin a hing vasa siang nih leh taamtak sing leh a ausan puan leh puknah a la dingin siampipa in amah sawl ding hi; tua ciangin siampipa kiangah paipih ding hi.
Tua khit ciangin siampipa in lei beel khat sunga kikoih tui siang tungah a vasa khat a kigo dingin thupia ding hi.
Amah in tua khit ciangin a hing vasa adang khat la ding a, taamtak sing leh a ausan puan leh puknah tawh tui siang tunga a kigo vasa’ sisan sungah diah ding hi.

Amah in phaknatna panin ahih keileh a kilawh thei natna panin a kisiangsak ding pa’ tungah sagihvei theh ding a, tua ciangin amah siang hi, ci-in kipulaak ding hi. Tua khit ciangin amah in a hing lai vasa pen gamlak ah khah ding hi.

Hih bangin ahih khit ciangin, giahphual sungah amah lut thei ding hi, ahih hangin puanbuk pua lamah ni sagih sung amah om hamtang ding hi. Tua khit ciangin mipa in a puansilhte sawp pelmawh ding a, a multe kiat-in tui tawh kisil hamtang ding hi; tua ciangin amah a siangin kiseh ding hi.

A ni sagih ni-in amah in a mul khempeuh kiat-in, amah in a sam mettolin, a khamul, a mitmul leh a mul dang khempeuh kiatkhia ding hi. Amah in a puansilhte sawp hamtang ding a, tui tawh kipumsil ding hi. Tua khit ciangin amah a siang ahi ding hi.

A ni giat ni-in amah in kum khat ciat a pha, a sitbaang lo tuuno a pa nih leh tuuno a nu khat, an tawh biakna dingin sathau tawh a kipawi annel limci ephah seh-sawm-suah-seh-thum leh sathau biingta khat tawh paipih hamtang ding hi.
Amah siang hi, ci-in a pulaak ding siampipa in a kisiangsak ding mipa, leh a biakpiaknate Kikhopna Puanbuk lama lutna Yahweh mai-ah paipih ding hi.
Tua khit ciangin siampipa in tuuno a pate panin khat la-in, sathau biingta khat tawh gamtat khialhna hanga biakna-in pia ding hi. Amah in Yahweh mai-ah vei-a biakna-in a nih-in a vei ding hi.

Tua khit ciangin amah in mawhna hanga biakna ganhing leh meihal biakna ganhing a gawhna mun, mun siangtho sungah amah in tua tuuno go ding hi. Mawhna hanga biakna siampipa a’ ahih mah bang tektekin gamtat khialhna hanga biakna zong siampipa a’ mah ahi hi. Hih pen a siangtho pen ahi hi.
Siampipa in gantat khialhna hanga biakna sisan tawmkhat la ding a, a kisiangsak ding mipa taklam bilteep tung leh a taklam khepi tungah nuh ding hi.
Siampipa in tua khit ciangin sathau biingta panin tawmkhat la-in, amah ngiat veilam khutkuak tungah sung ding a,
a khutkuak sunga sathau sungah a taklam khutme-kawk diahsuk-in, a sathau tawmkhat a khutme tawh Yahweh mai-ah sagih vei theh ding hi.

Siampipa in a khutkuak sunga a omlai sathau tawmkhat a kisiangsak ding mipa’ taklam bilteep tung, a taklam khutpi tung leh a taklam khepi tung, leh gamtat khialhna hanga biakna panin sisan a kizutsana mun tungah zut ding hi.
Ama khutkuak sunga a cianlai sathau pen siampipa in a kisiangsak ding mipa’ lu tungah zut ding hi. Tua ciangin siampipa in ama aa dingin Yahweh mai-ah mawhkhuhna bawlsak ding hi.

Tua ciangin siampipa in mawhna hanga biakna ganhing go ding a, ama nitna panin a kisiangsak ding mipa aa dingin mawhkhuhna bawlsak ding hi. Tua khit ciangin siampipa in meihal biakna ganhing go ding a,
an tawh biakna tawh biaknatau tungah tua pen piakhawm ding hi. Tua ciangin siampipa in ama aa dingin mawhkhuhna bawlsak ding hi; tua ciangin amah a siang hi ding hi.

Ahih hangin mipa a zawng mi hi-in hihte a neih zawh kei leh, amah in a kivei dingin leh ama aa ding mawhkhuhna a bawlna dingin gamtat khialhna hanga biakna-in tuuno a pa khat, an tawh biakna-in sathau tawh a kipawi annel limci ephah seh-sawm-suah-seh-khat, sathau biingta khat amah in paipih hamtang ding a,
amah in a neihzawh ding vakhu nih ahih keileh kawl vakhuno nih, khat pen mawhna hanga biakna ding hi ding a, adang khat pen meihal biakna ding hi ding hi.
A ni giat ni-in a kisiangsak ding mipa aa dingin Yahweh’ mai, Kikhopna Puanbuk lama lutna-a siampipa kiangah tuate amah in paipih ding hi.
Siampipa in gamtat khialhna hanga biakna dingin tuuno, sathau biingta tawh lakhawm ding a, vei-a biakna-in Yahweh mai-ah a nih-in vei ding hi.
Amah in gamtat khialhna hanga biakna tuuno go ding a, a sisan tawmkhat la-in, a kisiangsak ding mipa’ taklam bilteep tung, a taklam khutpi tung leh a taklam khepi tungah zut ding hi.
Siampipa in amah ngiat veilam khutkuak sungah sathau tawmkhat sung ding a,
a veilam khutkuak sunga om sathau tawmkhat a taklam khutme-kawk tawh Yahweh mai-ah sagih vei theh ding hi.

Ama khutkuak sunga sathau tawmkhat pen amah in gamtat khialhna hanga biakna sisan a zutna munte lian mah ahi, a kisiangsak ding mipa’ taklam bilteep tung, a taklam khutpi tung leh a taklam khepi tungah zut ding hi.
A veilam khutkuak sunga om sathau cianlai pen siampipa in Yahweh mai-ah mawhkhuhna a bawlna dingin a kisiangsak ding mipa lu tungah zut ding hi.
Tua khit ciangin amah in mipa piak zawh bangbang vakhute ahi a, kawl vakhunote ahi zongin go ding a,

ama piak zawhna bangin khat pen mawhna hanga biakna ding, leh adang khat pen meihal biakna ding, anih-in an tawh biakna tawh piakhawm ding hi. Tua ciangin siampipa in a kisiangsak ding mipa aa dingin Yahweh mai-ah mawhkhuhna bawlsak ding hi.
Hih pen ama sianna dingin a kipia ngei biakna a nei zolo phaknatna a nei khatpeuh ahi a, a kilawh thei vun natna a nei khatpeuh aa dingin Thukham ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah hopihin a gen inah:
“Note neih dinga Kong piak Canaan gam sungah lut-in, tua gam sunga inn khat sungah a ap kizel khat Ka koih ciangin,
Inn neipa hong pai-in siampipa kiangah: ka inn sungah a ap tawh a kibang bang-hiam-khat ka mu hi, ci-in gen ding hi.

Siampipa tua a ap a veel dingin a pai ma-in amah in inn sung a hawmin a om dingin thupia ding hi, tua hileh a inn sungah khatbeek zong a siang lo hi ci-in kipulaak lo ding hi. Hih khit ciangin, siampipa luttumin, tua inn a sittel ding hi.
Amah in kawm tungte-a a apte veel ding a, a kawm maitang sangin a thuktum zaw-in a hingmel ahih keileh a san mel pua-in a nekuak a om leh,
inn panin siampipa paikhia ding a, ni sagih sung tua inn kongkhak khakcip ding hi.
A ni sagih ni-in siampipa tua inn kantel dingin hong paikik ding hi. Tua a ap pen kawmte tungah a kizelh leh,
Amah in a ninsak thei tua a banna suangte lakhia-in, khuapi pualam a siang lo mun khat ah a paihkhiat nadingun thu pia ding hi.
Amah in inn sunglam kawmte khempeuh kiatsakin, a kikiatkhia nate pen khuapi pualam a siang lo mun ah buasak ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in adang suangte hih munte ah koihsakkik ding a, tungman thak la-in tua inn a zut ding hi.
Suangte kipaikhia khinin tua inn kikiatkhinin a kizut khit ciangin tua inn sungah a ap hong suahkik leh,
tua ciangin siampipa pai-in veel leuleu ding a, tua a ap pen inn sungah a kizelhkhit leh, tua pen a siahuai a ap ahi hi; tua inn a siang lo ahi hi.
Tua inn, a suangte, a singte, leh a zutna khempeuh phelkhia-in a siang lo mun ah khuapi panin kinawnkhia ding hi.
Tua inn a kikhak sungin a sungah a lut mi peuhmah ni tum matengin a siang lo hi ding hi.
Tua inn sunga a lum hitaleh, an a ne mi peuhmah in a puansilhte uh sawp hamtang ding hi.

Ahih hangin tua inn a veel dingin siampipa hong pai-in, tua inn a kizut khit ciangin a ap pen a kizelh kei leh, amah in tua inn siang hi, ci-in pulaak ding hi, bang hang hiam cihleh a ap teng beikhin hi.
Inn a hah ding leh a siangsak nadingin amah in vasa nih, taamtak sing pawlkhat, a ausan khau leh puknah amah in la ding a,
amah in lei beel khat sunga tui siang tungah vasate panin khat go ding hi.
Tua khit ciangin amah in taamtak sing, puknah, a ausan khau leh a hing lai vasa la-in, tui siang tawh a kihelkhawm a si vasa’ sisan sungah tuate diahsukin, tua inn sagih vei a theh ding hi.
Amah in vasa’ sisan, tui siang, a hing lai vasa, taamtak sing, puknah, leh a ausan khau tawh tua inn hahin a siangsak ding hi.
Tua khit ciangin amah in khuapi pualam gamlak ah a hing lai vasa khahkhia ding hi. Hih bang danin amah in tua inn aa dingin mawhkhuhna bawlsak ding a, tua inn a siang hi ding hi.
Hih pen phaknatna khatpeuh ahih keileh a kilawh thei vun natna khatpeuh, cithak aa ding,
puansilh tunga ahih keileh inn khat sunga a ap aa ding,
a bawk, a dulh, ahih keileh a vun kang bilbial aa ding,
khat peuhpeuh a siang leh a siang lo a om ciangin khensat nadingin Thukham ahi hi. Hih pen phaknatna ahih keileh a kilawh thei vun natna, leh a apkai tawh kisai Thukham ahi hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah hopihin a gen inah:
“Israyl mite kiangah thugen inla, amaute kiangah, ‘Pasal khatpeuh in a luangkhia na khatpeuh a neih ciangin, tua a luangkhia na pen a siang lo ahi hi.
Tua pen a pumpi tung panin a luangluang lai ahi a, a kang zel ahi zongin, tua in amah a siang lo suaksak hi.
Tua bangin a luangkhia a nei mi khatpeuh a kualna lupna pen a siang lo hi ding a, ama tutna peuhpeuh zong a siang lo hi ding hi.
Tua pa’ lupna a lawng mi peuhpeuh in a puansilhte sawp pelmawh ding a, tui tawh kipumsil hamtangin, ni tum mateng amah a siang lo hi ding hi.
A luangkhia thei na a neipa tutna na khat peuhpeuh tunga a tu mi peuhmah in a puansilhte sawp pelmawh ding a, tui tawh kipumsil hamtangin, ni tum matengin amah a siang lo hi ding hi.
Tua a luangkhia na a nei mipa’ cilesa a lawng mi peuhmah in a puansilhte sawp pelmawh ding a, tui tawh kipumsil hamtangin, ni tum matengin amah a siang lo hi ding hi.
A luangkhia na a nei mipa in a siang mi khat peuhpeuh tungah a cil a siat leh, tua mipa in a puansilhte sawp pelmawh ding a, tui tawh kipumsil hamtangin, ni tum mateng amah a siang lo hi ding hi.
Tua mipa a tuanna-a a tutna na khempeuh a siang lo hi ding a,

ama nuai-a om nate khat peuhpeuh a lawng mi peuhmah ni tum mateng a siang lo hi ding hi. Tua bang nate a tawm mi peuhmah in a puansilhte sawp pelmawh ding a, tui tawh kipumsil hamtangin, ni tum matengin amah a siang lo hi ding hi.

A luangkhia na a nei mi khatpeuh in a khutte tui tawh silsiang sitset lo pi-in a lawnkhak mi peuhmah in a puansilhte sawp pelmawh ding a, tui tawh kipumsil hamtangin, ni tum matengin amah a siang lo hi ding hi.
Tua mipa lawn lei beel khatpeuh kisukham ding a, sing tawh kibawl na khatpeuh tui tawh kisawp siang sitset ding hi.

Mipa, a luangkhia thei na panin a sian ciangin, a kisiansak nadingin amah in ni sagih sitset ngak ding hi. Amah in a puansilhte sawp pelmawh ding a, tui luang lai tawh amah kisil hamtangin, tua ciangin amah a siang hi ding hi.
A ni giat ni-in amah in vakhu nih ahih keileh kawl vakhuno nih la-in, Kikhopna Puanbuk lam lutna Yahweh mai-ah amah pai-in, siampipa kiangah tuate pia ding hi.

Siampipa in tuate go ding a, khat pen mawhna hanga biakna, leh adang khat pen meihal biakna ding hi ding hi. Tua ciangin siampipa in ama na a luankhiatna hangin ama aa dingin Yahweh mai-ah mawhkhuhna bawlsak ding hi.
Pasal khatpeuh in a na tui paikhiatsakna a neih ciangin tui sungah a pumpi khempeuh kipumsil ding a, ni tum matengin amah a siang lo hi ding hi.
Na tui a banna puansilh khatpeuh ahi a, savun khatpeuh ahi zongin tui tawh kisil pelmawh ding a, ni tum matengin a siang lo hi ding hi.
Numei khat tawh pasal khat lumkhawmin a na tui a paikhiatsak ciangin a nih tuakun tui tawh kipumsil hamtang ding a, ni tum matengin amaute a siang lo hi ding uh hi.
Numei khat in a neih ngei sisan luanna; niddah, zavah, a neihkhit ciangin, ni sagih sung ama a nin hi lai ding hi. Hih hun sungin tua nu a lawng mi peuhmah ni tum matengin a siang lo hi ding hi.
Ama nit hun sungin a lupna peuhpeuh a siang lo hi ding a, a tutna khat peuhpeuh zong a siang lo hi ding hi.
Ama lupna a lawng mi peuhpeuh in a puansilhte sawp pelmawh ding a, tui tawh kipumsil hamtangin, ni tum matengin amah a siang lo hi ding hi.
Tua nu tutna khat peuhpeuh a lawng mi peuhpeuh in a puansilhte sawp pelmawh ding a, tui tawh kipumsil hamtang ding a, ni tum matengin amah a siang lo hi ding hi.
Ama lupna ahi a, ama tutna ahi zongin, khatpeuh in a lawn ciangin, ni tum matengin amah a siang lo hi ding hi.
Tua nu tawh pasal khat lumin tua nu’ khasim nin in amah a sukkhak leh, ni sagih sung amah a siang lo hi ding hi; tua pa lupna peuhpeuh zong a siang lo hi ding hi.

Ama khasim nin; zavah, neihna hun-a sangin a ni tampi si luanna nei ahi a, ama nin neih hun; zavah, khengin a luangluang ahi zongin a neih ciangin, amah in a luangkhia a neih laisiah amah a siang lo hi ding hi. Ama nin neih hunte bang tektekin amah a siang lo hi ding hi.

Tua nu in a luangkhia a kizop hun sungin kualin a lupna peuhpeuh, a khasim nin neih hun sunga ama lupna mah bangin, a siang lo hi ding a, a khasim nin neihna hun-a bang tektekin tua nu tutna peuhpeuh a siang lo hi ding hi.
Tuate a lawng mi peuhmah a siang lo hi ding hi; amah in a puansilhte sawp pelmawh ding a, tui tawh kipumsil hamtangin, ni tum matengin amah a siang lo hi ding hi.
Ama na a luangkhia a tawp taktak ciangin, amah in ni sagih sitset sim ding hi; tua ciangin amah a siangin kiseh ding hi.
A ni giat ni-in tua nu in vakhu nih ahih keileh kawl vakhu nih la-in tuate Kikhopna Puanbuk lama lutna siampipa kiangah paipih ding hi.

Siampipa in khat pen mawhna hanga biakna aa dingin, leh adang khat pen meihal biakna-in go ding hi. Hih bang danin amah in ama na luangkhia-in; zavah, a sian lohna hangin Yahweh mai-ah tuanu aa dingin mawhkhuhna bawlsak ding hi.
Israyl mite a ninsak nate panin amaute kidawmin leh tuamkoih-in na na keem hamtang ding hi. Tua hileh amaute’ laka om KA BIAKBUK NITSAKNA TAWH amaute’ sianlohna panin a si kei ding uh hi.
Hihte pen a luangkhia thei a nei mipa aa ding, na tui khahkhiatna tawh a kininsak khat peuhpeuh aa ding,

a khasim nin; niddah, a nei numei aa ding, pasal’ na a luangkhia ahi a, numei’ na a luangkhia; zavah, ahi zongin a siang loin a kiseh numei khat tawh a lumkhawm mipa aa dingin Thukhamte; ngeinate, ahi hi.
Aaron’ tapa nihte in Yahweh mai-ah zahtak loin leh phalna ngah lo pi-in biakna a piak ciangun si a, a sihkhit ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh hopih hi.

Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “Singkuang tunga hehpihna tokom mai, Dalna puan nunga Siangtho Pen Mun; a Siangthote panin a Siangtho, mun ah na sanggampa Aaron a ut hunhunin a pai loh nadingin gen in; tua bang ahih keileh, amah si ding hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh hehpihna tokhom tunga meii sungah Kei ka kilang hi.
Hih pen Siangtho Pen Mun ah hong pai ding zia ahi hi: mawhna hanga biakna dingin bawngtal khanglai khat’ sisan leh meihal biakna dingin tuutal’ sisan hong paipih ding hi.

Amah in a siangtho saihadial puantungsilh silhin a pumpi tawh kizomin a sunglama kisilh puante silh ding hi. A kiimkotah amah in saihadial puan kawnggakna hen ding a, saihadial dialkhip khim ding hi. Hihte pen a siangtho puante ahi hi. Tua ahih manin amah in tuate a silh ma-in tui tawh amah mah kisil hamtang ding hi.
Amah in Israyl mihon kiang panin mawhna hanga biakna dingin keeltal nih, leh meihal biakna dingin tuutal khat la ding hi.
Aaron in amah mah aa ding leh a innkuanpihte aa ding mawhkhuhna a bawl nading mawhna hanga biakna dingin bawngtal pia masa ding hi;
Tua khit ciangin amah in keel nihte la ding a, Kikhopna Puanbuk lama lutna, Yahweh mai-ah tuate pia ding hi.
Amah in tua keel nite tungah aisanin, khat pen Yahweh aa ding, adang khat pen mawhpua-keel;azazel, a kihemkhia keel, aa ding ahi hi.
Aaron in Yahweh aa ding ai a pha keel paipih ding a, mawhna hanga biakna-in go ding hi.
Ahih hangin aisanna tawh a kiteel mawhpua-keel pen gamlak ah mawhpua-keel kiangah a kipuak theih nadingin mawhkhuhna bawl nadingin a hingin Yahweh mai-ah kipaipih ding hi.
Aaron in amah mah aa ding leh a innkuanpihte aa dingin mawhkhuhna a bawlna dingin mawhna hanga biakna-in bawngtal paipih ding a, a mawhna hanga biakna bawngtal go ding hi.
Amah in Yahweh mai-a biaknatau panin mei-am a dim paknamtui beel khat leh hoih takin a kisunen paknamtui khut nih dim la ding a, Dalna puan nungah tawi ding hi.
Amah in Yahweh mai-a mei tungah tua paknamtui koih ding a, paknamtui khu in Tecipanna tung-a hehpihna tokhom tuam ding hi. Tua hileh amah si lo ding hi.
Amah in bawngtal’ sisan kimkhat la-in, a khutme tawh hehpihna tokhom a mailam tungah thehin, hehpihna tokhom mai-ah amah in sagih vei theh ding hi.

Amah in tua khit ciangin mite aa dingin mawhna hanga biakna keel go ding a, Dalna puan nungah a sisan tawi-in, bawngtal’ sisan tawh a hih bangin tua tawh hih ding hi: Amah in hehpihna tokhom tung leh tua mai-ah a sisan theh ding hi.

Hih bang danin, amah in Israyl mite’ sianlohna hang, a lehdona hang, leh a bawlkhitsa uh amau’ mawhnate peuhpeuh hangin Siangtho Pen Mun aa dingin mawhkhuhna bawlsak ding hi. Amah in amaute sianlohna laizanga amaute laka a omlai Kikhopna Puanbuk aa dingin tua tawh a kibangin bawl ding hi.

Siangtho Pen Mun ah mawhkhuhna bawl dingin Aaron a lut-a kipan, amah leh a innkuanpihte aa ding, Israyl mihon buppi aa ding mawhkhuhna bawlin, amah hong pusuah matengin Kikhopna Puanbuk sungah kuamah om lo ding hi.

Tua khit ciangin Yahweh mai-a om biaknatau ah amah hong paikhia-in, tua aa dingin mawhkhuhna bawlsak ding hi. Amah in bawngtal’ sisan kimkhat leh keel’ sisan kimkhat la ding a, biaknatau’ kite tungah zut ding hi.
Amah in Israyl mite sianglohna panin biaknatau a siangsak ding, a sehtuam ding leh a siangthosak dingin tua tunga sisan kimkhat a khutme tawh sagih vei theh ding hi.
Siangtho Pen Mun, Kikhopna Puanbuk;mun siangtho, leh biaknatau aa ding mawhkhuhna bawlna Aaron a mankhit ciangin, amah in a nungta keel pen paipih ding hi.

Aaron in a nungta keel’ lu tungah a khutte nih nga ding a, Israyl mite’ gamtat siatnate leh a thu palsatnate khempeuh, amau’ mawhnate leh langdona khempeuh tawh kizui-in keel tungah pulaak ding hi; keel lu tungah tuate suanin, a sem dingin a kisehsa mipa khutin sehnel gam sungah sawlkhia ding hi.
Keel in amau’ mawhnate khempeuh pua-in, sehnel gam sung gamdai mun khat ah amah in tua keel a khah ding hi.
Tua khit ciangin Kikhopna Puanbuk sungah Aaron pai ding a, Siangtho Pen Mun ah amah a lut ma-in a silh saihadial puante suahkhia-in tua lai mun ah nusia ding hi.

Amah mah a siangtho mun khat sungah tui tawh kipumsil ding a, a puansilh ngeite silh ding hi. Tua khit ciangin amah pusuakkhia ding a, ama aa ding leh mite aa ding mawhkhuhna a bawl nadingin ama aa ding meihal biakna leh mite aa ding meihal biakna ganhing go ding hi.
Amah in biaknatau tungah mawhna hanga biakna sa a thaute zong hal ding hi.
Mawhpua-keel a khah pa in a puansilhte sawp pelmawh ding a, tui tawh amah kipumsil hamtang ding hi. Tua khit ciangin giahphual sungah amah lut thei ding hi.

Mawhna hanga biakna ding mawhkhuhna bawlna dingin Siangtho Pen Mun sunga a sisan a kipaipih bawngtal leh keel pen giahphual pualamah pel loin kipaikhiatpih ding hi. Tua lai munah, a vunte, a sa leh a ek-te kihaltum ding hi.
Tuate a hal mipa in pel loin a puansilhte sawp ding a, tui tawh kipumsil hamtang ding hi. Tua khit ciangin giahphual sungah amah lut thei ding hi.

Hih pen note aa dingin tawntung ngeina kip khat ahi hi: Note gam sung mahmah a tualsung mi ahi a, note laka a hong peem khualmi ahi zongin Kha Sagih Kha, Ni Sawm Ni-in note na kigawt ding uh a; pel loin an na tang ding uh a, nasep na sem kei ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh tua ni pen Yahweh mai-ah na mawhnate khempeuh panin na sian nadingun note aa dingin MAWHKHUHNA NI ahi hi.
Tua pen note aa dingin a thupi tawlngak Shabbat khat hi a, note na kigawt ding uh hi. Tua pen tawntung ngeina kip khat ahi hi.
Sathau a kinilh, a kisehtuam, Siampi Lian-in a pa za laih dingin a kikipsak siampipa in mawhkhuhna bawl ding hi. Amah in a siangtho saihadial puante silh ding a,
Siangtho Pen Mun a’ding, Kikhopna Puanbuk; Mun Siangtho, leh biaknatau aa ding, siampite aa ding, mihonpi khempeuh aa dingin mawhkhuhna bawlsak ding hi.

Hih pen Israyl mite aa ding kum khatin khat vei amau’ mawhnate khempeuh a ding mawhkhuhna bawlna dingin note aa dingin bei hun neilo ngeina kip khat hi ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh a thupiak bangin amah in a gamta hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh hopihin a gen inah:
“Aaron, a tapate leh Israyl mi khempeuh hopih inla, amaute kiangah, ‘Yahweh thupiaksa hi bang ahi hi:
Giahphual sungah ahi a, a pualamah ahi zongin bawng hitaleh, lawi hitaleh, tuuno hitaleh, keel hitaleh biakpiakna a pia Israyl innkuan pasal khatpeuh in

Yahweh’ Biakbuk mai, Yahweh’ tungah biakna-in a pia dingin Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna ah a paipih lo peuhmah, tua mipa pen sisan luansak khialhna-in kiseh ding hi. Amah in sisan luangsakkhin ahih manin a mipihte kiang panin kibeimangsak ding hi.

Hih bangin piangpah a, Israyl mite in gamlak mun awng-a a biakpiakna a bawlbawlte uh Yahweh kiangah hong paipih ding uh hi. Amaute in Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna, Yahweh kiang, siampipa tungah tuate paipih hamtang ding a, kilemna biakna-in tuate pia ding uh hi.
Siampipa in Yahweh’ biaknatau lam ahi lo, Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna ah sisan theh ding a, Yahweh a lungkimhuai gim namtui-in a thaute hal ding hi.

Amaute a paktatkhitna, a kizuakna uh dawite (pasiante, elohim) tungah amau’ biakpiaknate khat beek zong pia nawn peuhmah lo ding uh hi. Hih pen a khang khangin amaute aa dingin tawntung ngeina kip khat ahi ding hi.
Amaute kiangah gen in: Israyl innkuan sung mi hitaleh, note laka hong peem khualmi khatpeuh hitaleh, meihal biakna ahi a, biakpiakna ahi zongin a pia peuhpeuh in,
