Yahweh tungah biakpiakna pia dingin Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna ah a biakpiakna a paipih kei leh, tua mipa pen a mipihte kiang panin kibeimangsak ding hi.
Israyl innkuan sung mi hitaleh, note laka hong peem khualmi khatpeuh hitaleh, sisan a ne mi peuhpeuh, tua sisan a ne mi ka maisiat ding a, ama mipihte lak panin ka hawlkhia ding hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh pumpi nuntakna pen sisan sungah om a, biaknatau tungah mawhkhuhna bawlna dingin note aa dingin note tungah tua sisan Ka hong piakhin hi. Hih pen khatpeuh nuntakna aa dingin mawhkhuhna bawlna sisan ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Israyl mite kiangah Ka hong gen hi: Note lakah kuamah in sisan na ne kei ding uh a, note laka a hong peem khualmi peuhmah in zong sisan ne lo ding hi.

Israyl mite khatpeuh hitaleh, note laka hong peem khualmite khat peuhpeuh hitaleh, a kine thei vasa ahi a ganhing khatpeuh ahi zongin bengin a man pa in a sisan buakhia ding a, leivui tawh vuk ding hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh sisan pen ganhing khempeuh nuntakna ahi hi. A sisan in a nuntakna a len hi. Tua ahih ciangin Keimah in Israyl mite kiangah kong ci hi: ganhing khatpeuh’ sisan na ne kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh ganhing khempeuh nuntakna pen a sisan ahi hi. Sisan a ne mi peuhmah kibeimangsak ding hi.

A sisa-a kimu peuhpeuh hitaleh gamsate in a balnen hitaleh a ne mi peuhmah, tualsung mi ahi a, peemta ahi zongin, tua mipa in a puansilhte sawpin tui sungah kipumsil ding a, ni tum matengin a siang lo hi ding hi; tua khit ciangin amah a siang hi ding hi.
Ahih hangin amah in a puansilhte ahi a, a pumpi tui sungah ahi zongin a sil kei leh, amah mawhna amah in pua ding hi,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah a gen inah:
“Israyl mite kiangah thugen inla, amaute kiangah, ‘Kei pen Yahweh note Pa ka hi hi.
Note na tenna uh Egypt gam-a gamtatnate bangin na gamta kei ding uh a, note kong paipihna Canaan gam-a gamtatnate bangin na gamta kei ding hi; amau biakna thukhamte zong na zui kei ding uh hi.
Note in Ka thukhennate hoih takin ciamtehin na gamta ding uh a, Ka thukhamte zui-in na gamta ding uh hi. Kei pen Yahweh ka hi hi.
Note in tua ahih ciangin Ka ngeina kipte leh Ka thukhennate pel loin na zui ding uh a, mi khatpeuh in tuate a zuih leh, tuate tungtawnin amah nungta ding hi. Keimah Yahweh ka hi hi.
Note kuamah in na kinaipih tanaute mawhpih dingin na neh kei ding uh hi. Keimah Yahweh ka hi hi.
Na pa zum huaina pen na nu zum huaina mah hi a, nang in tuate na pholak kei ding hi. Amah pen na nu ahi hi. Amah tawh mawh kei in.
Na pianna nu lian ahih loh hangin, Na pa’ zi tawh mawh kei in. Tua pen na pa’ aa ding zumhuaina ahi hi.
Omna inn-a suak ahi a, gamdanga suak ahi zongin, na pa’ tanu hitaleh, na nu’ tanu hitaleh, na sanggamnu tawh na mawh kei ding hi.
Na tunute ahi, na tapa’ tanu tawh ahi a, na tanu’ tanu tawh ahi zongin na mawh peuhmah kei ding hi. Amau’ zumhuaina kisel thei lo ding hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh amaute pen nangma cilesa mah ahi hi.
Na pa suan ahi na pa’ zi’ tanu tawh na mawh peuhmah kei ding hi; amah na sanggamnu ahi hi. Nangmah in amah na mindaisak kei ding hi.
Na pa’ sanggamnu tawh na mawh kei ding hi. Amah pen na pa’ kinaipih numei mah ahi hi.
Na nu’ sanggamnu tawh na mawh kei ding hi. Amah pen na nu’ kinaipih numei mah ahi hi.
Na pa’ sanggampa’ zi tawh na mawh kei ding hi. Nangmah in a zi na neh kei ding hi. Amah pen na nuno ahi hi.
Na monu’ zahhuaina na pholak kei ding hi. Amah pen na tapa zi ahi a, amah tawh na mawh kei ding hi.
Na sanggampa’ zi tawh na mawh kei ding hi. Amah pen na sanggampa a’ ahi hi.

Nangmah in a nu leh a tanu na tenpih khawm kei ding a, a tapa’ tanu hitaleh a tanu’ tanu hitaleh mawhpih dingin na la kei ding hi. Amaute pen a kinaipih numeite hi a, tua pen gitlohna leh siathuaina ahi hi.
Nangmah in a sanggamnu a hingsuan dingin numei khat na tenpih peuhmah kei ding a, a masa nu hing laipi-in a nihna nu na mawhpih kei ding hi.
Tua banah, nangmah in numei khat khasim nin nei-a a nit hun sung ahi a, tua dan mahin sianlohna khat peuhpeuh hun sung ahi zongin tua numei tawh na mawh kei ding hi.
Tua bek tham loin na vengpa’ zi tawh nangmah mah a kininsak dingin amah tawh na mawh kei ding hi.

Nangmah in Molech tungah biakpiakna-a piak dingin na tate khat peuhpeuh mei sung na nawksak kei ding hi. Pasiante (elohim) tungah na tate piakna tawh nangmah in Yahweh’ Min na daisak kei ding hi. Kei pen Yahweh ka hi hi.
Numei tawh mawh bangin pasal tawh na mawh kei ding uh hi. Tua pen a kihhuai mahmah ahi hi.

Ganhing tawh nangmah mah s kininsak dingin ganhing khat peuhpeuh tawh na mawh kei ding a, numei khatpeuh in zong ganhing khatpeuh tawh a mawh dingin kipia lo ding hi. Tua pen ngeina hi lo a, lehtatna ahi hi.
Hih bang dante khat peuhpeuh sungah no-le-no kininsak kei un. Bang hang hiam cihleh note na kinitsak ma-in Ka hawlkhiat ding minamte hihci bangte mahin gamta uh hi.
Leitang nin hi. Tua ahih manin tua leitang tunga om mawhna hangin dan ka pia a, tua leitang mahmah in a tunga teng mite a luakhia hi.

Note in tua ahih manin Ka ngeina kipte leh Ka thukhennate na zui ding uh a, hih a kihhuaite khatpeuh na gamta peuhmah kei ding uh hi. Tualsuak mi khatpeuh in ahi a, note laka hong peem khualmi khatpeuh ahi zongin na hihte na gamta peuhmah kei ding uh hi—
(bang hang hiam cihleh hih kihhuainate khempeuh note’ ma-a a om gam mite gamta uh hi. Tua ahih manin leitang nin hi; siangtho lo hi.)—
tua bang ahih keileh leitang in note’ ma-a om minamte a luakkhiat bangin note in leitang na nitsak uh leh, amah in note hong luakhia ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh hih kihhuainate khat peuhpeuh a gamta peuhmah, tuate a gamta mi ama mite lak panin kibeimangsak ding hi.

Tua ahih ciangin tuate tawh no-le-no na kinitsak loh nadingun note mai-a a kigamta hih a kihhuai gamtatnate khat beek zong na gamta kei ding uh a, Ka thukham na zui ding uh hi. Kei pen Yahweh note Pa ka hi hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah a gen inah:
“Israyl mihon khempeuh kiangah thugen inla, amaute kiangah, ‘Keimah, Yahweh note’ Vantung Pa Siangtho ka hih manin note zong na siangtho ding uh hi.
Note a kuamah peuh in na nu leh na pa uh na zahtak ding uh a, Ka Shabbat-te na zui ding uh hi. Kei pen Yahweh note Pa ka hi hi.
Pasiante (elohim) lamah kihei kei unla, a kisungtawm milimte zong bawl kei un. Kei pen Yahweh note Pa ka hi hi.
Note in Yahweh’ tungah kilemna biakpiakna na piak uh leh, no mahmah lungsim kiphalna tawh na pia ding uh hi.
Tua pen na a kipiak ni leh a zingciangin zong kine thei ding hi; ahih hangin a ni thum ni dong a cianlai a om leh, tua pen mei sungah kihal pelmawh ding hi.
A ni thum ni-in tua pen a kinek peuhmah leh, tua pen a kihhuai mahmah ahi hi. Tua ahih ciangin tua pen Yahweh in sang lo ding hi.
Tua a ne mi peuhmah in ama mawhna amah mah in pua ding hi, bang hang hiam cihleh amah in Yahweh’ tunga a siangtho na a ninsak hi; tua mi pen ama mipihte kiang panin kibeimangsak ding hi.
Na leitang tung panun an na lak uh ciangun, na lo nawlte dongin an na la kei ding uh a, na an sangte zong na khawm kei ding uh hi.

Note in na leenggah lo uh na hawkmai kei ding uh a, na leenggah lo a a gah peuhpeuh zong na khawm gai kei ding uh hi. Tuate pen a zawngte leh khualmite aa dingin na nusia ding uh hi. Kei pen Yahweh note Pa ka hi hi.
Note in na gu loin, a man loin na gamta kei ding uh a, khatlekhat zong na kikhem kei ding uh hi.
Ka Min tawh a man lo pi-in kiciam kei un, tua hileh note Pa’ Min a daisak na hi ding uh hi.
Na vengpa na khem kei ding a, a van zong na sut kei ding hi. A kicial nasempa’ thaman pen a zingsang dong zan tawntung na kemcip kei ding uh hi.
A bilngong mi samsia kei inla, mittawte mai a khaktan ding na koih kei in; na Pa uh na zahtak ding hi. Kei pen Yahweh ka hi hi.

Thukhenna-ah thutang lehhei kei un: note in a zawngte na langgen gawp kei ding uh a, mi liante tungah maipha zong na lak tuan kei ding uh hi. Thumanna tawh na vengte uh’ thu man takin na khen ding uh hi.
Note in na mipihte lakah mi gensia-in ahi a, zuau thu na gen sawn ahi zongin na kawi vak kei ding uh hi. Na vengpa’ nuntakna a beisak thei na peuhmah sem kei un. Kei pen Yahweh ka hi hi.

Na lungsim takpi tawh na vengte na mudah kei ding uh hi. Na sanggampa hitaleh na sanggamnu hitaleh hoihtakin tai in, tua hileh na vengpa’ khialhna ahi a, na vengnu’ khialhna ahi zongin na khialhpih kei ding hi.

Note in thukkikna na bawl kei ding uh a, na mipihte khatpeuh langah galbawlna zong na nei kei ding uh hi. Nang le nang na ki-it mah bangin na vengpa; na sanggam ahi a, na gal ahi zongin, na it ding hi. Kei pen Yahweh ka hi hi.

Ka ngeina kipte pel loin na zui ding uh hi. Na gankhawite uh nam kibang lo khat tawh na bah peuhmah kei ding uh hi. Na lo sung ah khaici na pawi khawm kei ding uh hi. Kikhopna Puanbuk sunga a kibawl a siangtho nate bangin a kigan saihadial puan leh samul puan na silh kei ding uh hi.

Mi dang khat zi neu dingin zu thawl a kipiasa, kitankhia nai loin suhtakna zong a kipia nai lo sila numei tawh a mawh mi peuhmah, a kituak zah dantatna om ding hi; ahih hangin amaute in that lo ding uh hi, bang hang hiam cihleh tua nu a suakta nai kei hi.
A khial mipa in khialhna hanga biakna tuutal khat Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna, Yahweh kiangah khialhna hanga biakna-in paipih ding hi.
Siampipa in, tua pa gamtatnasa mawhna hangin tua pa aa dingin Yahweh’ mai-a khialhna hanga biakna tuutal tawh mawhkhuhna bawlsak ding hi. Tua ciangin ama gamtatsa mawhna pen kimaisak ding hi.

Canaan gam sungah note na tun uh ciangin, singgah kung nam khempeuh na suan ding uh a, a singgah pen vun a ki-at lo bangin; a kikhaam bangin, na seh ding uh hi. Kum thum sung note aa dingin a kikhaam hi ding a, tua singgahte kine lo ding hi.
A kum lina sungin singgah khempeuh a siang hi ding a, siampite tungah na piak ding uh Yahweh’ tungah PHATA BIAKNA ahi hi.
Tua khit ciangin a kum nga na sungin note in a singgahte na ne thei ding uh hi. Hih bang danin na khawhsate uh khang semsem ding hi. Kei pen Yahweh note Pa ka hi hi.
Note in na khat peuhpeuh sisan tawh na ne kei ding uh hi. Thumuh kholh theina ahi a, mailam thu genkholhna ahi zongin na sem kei ding uh hi.
Na baa samte, na lu kiimkot-a mulnelte na kiat kei ding a, na khamul mongte a kilawm loin bawlin na khamul mongte zong na tan kei ding uh hi.
Note in mi site’ hangin dahna limin na ci tung uh na liamsak kei ding uh a, na ci tungah ciaptehna zong sunin na suai kei ding uh hi.
A kizuak numei a suak dingin na tanu uh paktatsak kei un; tua bang hi keileh tua gam kizuakna gam suak ding a, tua gam pen gitlohna tawh kidim ding hi.
Ka Munsiangtho ah ka Shabbat-te zuihna tawh note in Keimah nong zahtak ding uh hi; Kei pen Yahweh ka hi hi.
Vankah-te ahi a, kha tawh a kizawlte lamah kihei kei un. Tuate tawh kininsak dingin tuate kanin nei kei un. Kei pen Yahweh ka hi hi.
Sam kang mite mai-ah zahtakna tawh ding unla, note Vantung Pa zahtak piakna-in Khanghamte leh Siate na zahtak ding uh hi. Kei pen Yahweh ka hi hi.
Na gam sung uh ah note tawh khualmi khatpeuh hong ten leh, amah bawlsia kei un.

Note tawh hong teng khualmi pen tualsuak mi khat mah bangin pel loin na bawl ding uh a, nang le nang na ki-it mah bangin amah na it ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Egypt gam ah note khualmi na hi uh hi. Kei pen Yahweh ka hi hi.
A sau tehna, a gik tehna, a tam tehnate ah a man lo vantehnate zang kei un.

Note in a langnihin a kikim vantehna man, a giktehna man, ephah a man; a keu vantehna, leh hin man; a tui lamsang tehna, na zang ding uh hi. Kei pen Egypt gam panin note hong paikhiatpih Yahweh note Pa ka hi hi;
Tua ahih ciangin note in Ka ngeina kipte leh Ka thukhennate pel loin zui-in na tang ding uh a, tuate na sem ding uh hi. Kei pen Yahweh ka hi hi,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah a gen inah:

“Israyl mite’ kiangah thugenkik in: Israyl mite laka khatpeuh hitaleh tua gam sunga note tawh hong teng khualmite laka khatpeuh hitaleh, Molech tungah a tate khatpeuh a pia mipa kithat taktak ding hi. Tua gama mite in suang tawh amah denglum ding uh hi.
Tua mipa Ka maisiat ding a, a mipihte kiang panin Ka hawlkhia ding hi; Molech1 tungah a tate a piakna hangin amah in Ka Munsiangtho ninsak a, Ka Min Siangtho a daisak hi.
Tua mipa in Molech tungah a tate pawlkhat a piak ciangin a gam sunga mite kimuhmawh bawlin amaute in tua pa a thah kei leh,

tua tak ciangin tua mipa leh ama innkuan Ka maisiat ding a, a mipihte kiang panin Ka hawlkhia ding hi; amah leh Molech tungah amau mah a kipaktatsak tawmte a zui khempeuh a mipihte kiang panin Ka beimangsak ding hi.
Vankah-te leh kha tawh a kizawlte lamah amau mahmah tuate tawh a paktat dingin a kihei mi peuhmah, tua mi langah Ka maisiat ding a, a mipihte kiang panin Ka hawlkhia ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin nomau mah ki-apin kisiansuah unla, siangtho un; bang hang hiam cihleh Kei pen Yahweh note Pa ka hi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin note in Ka ngeina kipte pel loin na zui-in na tang ding uh a, tuate na sem ding uh hi; Kei pen note hong sehtuamin hong siangthosak Yahweh ka hi hi.
Mi khatpeuh in a nu ahi a, a pa ahi zongin a samsiat leh, amah kithat taktak ding hi. Amah in a pa ahi a, a nu ahi zongin a samsia hi. Ama sisan ama lu tung mah tu ding hi.
Pasal khat mi dang khat’ zi tawh ahi a, a sanggampa’ zi tawh ahi zongin a mawh leh, a mawh pa leh a mawh nu kithat taktak ding hi.
A pa’ zi tawh a mawh mipa in a pa a daisakkhin a hi hi; a mawh tenih kithat taktak ding hi. Amau’ sisan amau’ lu tung mah tu ding hi.
Pasal khat a monu tawh na mawh leh, a mawh tenih kithat taktak ding hi. Amaute a uangtatkhin uh ahi hi. Amau’ sisan amau’ lu tung mah tu ding hi.
Pasal khat in numei tawh mawhna a bawl mah bangin pasal tawh a mawh leh, amau tegel kihhuaina a gamtakhin uh ahi hi. Amaute kithat taktak ding hi. Amau’ sisan amau’ lu tung mah tu ding hi.
Pasal khat in numei khat tenpihin a nu zong a tenpih leh, tua pen gitlohna ahi hi. Note lakah gitlohna a om loh nadingin mipa leh amaute mei tawh kihal ding hi.
Ganhing khatpeuh tawh pasal khat a mawh leh, amah kithat taktak ding a, note in a ganhing zong na that ding uh hi.
Numei khat in ganhing khat naihin tua ganhing tawh a mawh leh, note in tua numei leh a ganhing na that ding uh hi. Amaute kithat taktak ding hi. Amau’ sihna amau mah ngawh ding ahi hi.

Pasal khat in a pa’ tanu ahi a, a nu’ tanu ahi zongin a sanggamnu a tenpihin a luppih leh, hih pen gitlohhuai na khat ahi hi. A mipihte muhna panin pel loin amaute kibeimangsak ding hi; Amah in a sanggamnu a daisak hi a, ama mawhna amahmah in pua ding hi.

Numei khat a khasim nin;niddah, a neih laitakin ahi a, ama sianlohna adang khatpeuh;zavah, a neih laitak ahi zongin pasal khat in luppihin tua nu tawh a mawh leh, amah in a siluanna bulpi a pholaksak hi a, numei in zong a sel lo mah ahi hi. Amau’ mipihte kiang panin amau tegel kibeimangsak ding hi.
Na nu’ sanggamnu tawh ahi a, na pa’ sanggamnu tawh ahi zongin mawh kei in; bang hang hiam cihleh tua in a kinaina daisak hi. Amaute in amau khialhna pua ding uh hi.
Pasal khat a pa’ sanggampa’ zi tawh a mawh leh, amah in a pa’ sanggampa a daisakkhin ahi hi. Amaute in amau mawhna pua ding uh a, ta nei loin si ding uh hi.
Pasal khat in a sanggampa’ zi a tenpih leh, tua pen a nitna khat hi a, a siang lo ahi hi. Amah in a sanggampa a daisak ahi hi. Amaute ta nei loin si ding uh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin note in Ka ngeina kipte khempeuh leh Ka thukhennate khempeuh pel loin zui-in na tang ding uh a, tuate na sem ding uh hi; tua hileh note ten nadingin Ka hong paipihna leitang in note hong luakhia lo ding hi.
Note mai panin Ka hawlkhiat ding minamte gamtat bangin na gamta peuhmah kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh hih nate khempeuh amaute gamta uh a, Keimah in amaute kihin Ka muhdah mahmah hi.
Ahi zongin note kiangah Kong gen inah: Note in amau gam na luah ding uh a, bawngnawi leh khuaizu a luanna gam na neih ding un note tungah Ka hong pia ding hi, kong cikhin zo hi.

Tua ahih manin note in ganhing nin leh ganhing siang, vasa a nin leh a siang na khentel pelmawh ding uh hi. Keimah in note aa dingin a siang loin ka tuamkoihte ahi: Ganhing tawh ahi a, vasa tawh ahi a, leilaka a gamtang a nungta ganhing nam khat peuhpeuh tawh ahi zongin nomau mah a kihhuai-in na kibawl tawm kei ding uh hi.

Note pen Kei aa dingin a siangtho na hi ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Keimah, Yahweh a Siangtho ka hi a, minamte kiang panin note hong khenkhia-in kong tuamkoih hi; Keima mite ahi dingin note kong samkhia hi.
Pasal ahi a, numei ahi zongin vankah hitaleh, kha tawh a kizawlte hitaleh kithat taktak ding hi; suang tawh amaute kidenglum ding hi. Amau’ sisan amau’ lu tung mah tu ding hi,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah thugen a, “Aaron’ tapa siampite kiangah thugen inla, amaute kiangah, ‘A mipihte laka a si khatpeuh hangin siampite kuamah kininsak tawm lo ding a,
amah tawh a kinai mahmah ahi a, a kinaipih hihte lobuang tawh: ama pumpi mah ahi a zi, a nu, a pa, a tapa, a tanu, leh a sanggam pasalte ahi hi;
Ahih hangin ama tunga kinga a sanggamnu, tua nu in pasal nei lo ahih manin tua nu’ hangin amah a nin kisuah thei ding hi.
Tua banah ama dai nadingin ama mipihte laka ukpi khat hihna tawh amah mah a siang loin kibawlin kininsak tawm peuhmah lo ding hi.*
Siampite in a lu uh kiattol peuhmah lo ding a, amau’ khamul nawlhui zong kiat loin, a ci tung uh kiliamsak tawm lo ding uh hi.

A Pa uh tungah amaute siangtho ding uh a, amau’ Pa uh Min a daisak kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh a Pa’ anlum ahi, mei tawh kihal Yahweh’ biakna amaute in pia uh a, amaute a siantho ding uh ahi hi.
Amaute in kizuak numei hitaleh a pasal kiang panin a tuam om, a kikhensa numei hitaleh a nin numei tenpih peuhmah lo ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh siampi cih pen Yahweh’ tungah a siangtho ahi hi.

Tua ahih ciangin amah a siangtho-in na sang ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amah in Yahweh’ anlum biakna a pia hi. Amah pen note aa dingin a siangtho hi ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Keimah, Yahweh, note a siangtho-a hong tuamkoihpa Ka Siangtho hi.
Siampipa’ tanu in paktatna tawh amah le amah a kinitsak leh, ama pa a daisak ahi hi. Mei tawh amah kihal ding hi.

Ama sanggamte laka Siampi Lianpa, a lu tungah nilh sathau a kisunnapa, a puante silh dingin a ki-apkhin siampipa in a samte phiahsak peuhmah loin, mi khatpeuh bangbang a piang hangin dahna hangin a puante zong balkek peuhmah lo ding hi.
Amah pen a nu leh a pa nangawn ahi zongin misi luang khatpeuh kiangah pai loin, amah mah kininsak tawm peuhmah lo ding a,
a Pa Yahweh’ Munsiangtho panin zong paikhia loin, min daisak lo ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amah pen Yahweh’ sathau nilhna tawh kisehtuamin ki-apkhin hi. Kei pen Yahweh ka hi hi.
Siampi Lianpa tenpih ding pen nungak siangtho hi hamtang ding hi.

Amah in pasian-bia numei ahi a, a pasal kiang panin a paikhia a kikhensa numei ahi a, kizuakna tawh a kininsak numei ahi zongin tenpih peuhmah lo ding a, ama mipihte mahmah sung panin nungak siangtho1 khat zi dingin tenpih ding hi.
Hih bang danin amah in a mipihte ama tuletate min daisak lo ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Kei pen a siangtho-in amah a tuamkoih Yahweh ka hi hi,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah a gen inah:
“Aaron kiangah hi bangin gen in: A piang lai ding na suanlekhakte panin poina a nei mi peuhmah in a Vantung Pa’ anlum pia dingin hong neh lo ding hi.
Poina a nei mi peuhmah ahi: mittaw hitaleh, khelbai hitaleh, maihem hitaleh, khut leh khe a ngei bang lo mi hitaleh,
a khut ahih keileh a khe a kitan mi hitaleh,
elkul mi hitaleh, mi cingtaak lo hitaleh, mit hoih lo mi hitaleh, meima nasia a nei mi leh meima nai luangluang a nei mi hitaleh, ciltang kitam mi hitaleh hong neh lo ding hi.

Siampi Aaron’ suanlekhakte panin poina a nei mi peuhmah in Yahweh’ tungah mei tawh kihal biakna pia lo ding hi. Amah in poina nei ahih manin a Vantung Pa kiangah anlum pia dingin hong neh peuhmah lo ding hi.
Ahi zongin amah in a Vantung Pa’ anlum ahi, a siangtho pen biakna ante leh a siangtho biakna ante ne thei ding a,

amah in Dalna puan ahi a, biaknatau ahi zongin neh lo bek ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amah in poina nei ahih manin Ka Munsiangtho a daisak ahi ding hi. Kei pen amaute a siangtho-in a tuamkoih Yahweh ka hi hi, ci in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Mosheh in Aaron leh a tapate, leh Israyl mite khempeuh kiangah hih thu a gen hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah a gen inah:
“Israyl mite in Kei’ tungah hong ap uh a siangtho biaknate zahtakna tawh a san nadingin gen in, tua hileh amaute in Ka Min Siangtho a daisak lo ahi ding uh hi. Kei pen Yahweh ka hi hi.

Amaute kiangah, ‘A khangkhangin na suanlekhakte panin a sianloh sungin Yahweh’ tungah Israyl mite in apin a sianthosak uh a siangtho nate’ nai-ah a pai mi peuhmah, Ka Omna panin tua mi kibeimangsak ding hi. Kei pen Yahweh ka hi hi.

Aaron suanlekhakte panin phaknatna a nei mi hitaleh, a kilawh thei vun natna a nei mi hitaleh, pumpi panin a luangkhia a nei mi hitaleh in amah a siang ahih matengin a siangtho biakna ante ne thei lo ding hi. Misi luang lawnna tawh a siangtho lo pa hitaleh a na tui a khahkhia pa hi taleh,
amah a ninsak a awmtal khatpeuh a lawngpa hitaleh, amah a ninsak mi khat peuhpeuh hitaleh a lawngpa, a nitna bangbang hitaleh amah zong a siang lo hi ding hi.
Tua bang nate khatpeuh a lawng mi pen ni tum matengin a siang lo hi ding hi. Tui tawh amah a kipumsil khit kei buang leh amah in a siang biakna ante khat mahmah zong ne peuhmah lo ding hi;
Ni a tumsuk ciangin amah a siang hi ding hi; tua khit ciangin amah in a siangtho biakna ante ne thei ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh tua pen ama an ahi hi.
A sisa-a kimu ahi a, gamsate balgawpte ahi zongin khat mahmah zong tua tawh a nin a suak dingin amah in ne peuhmah lo ding hi. Kei pen Yahweh ka hi hi.

Tua ahih ciangin amaute in Ka thukham zui ding uh hi, tua hileh amaute a khial suak lo ding uh a, amaute mindaina hangin simmawhna tawh a si kei ding uh hi. Kei pen amaute a siangtho-in a tuamkoih Yahweh ka hi hi.
Siampi’ innkuan pualam mi kuamah in a siangtho biakna ante ne thei lo ding uh a, siampipa’ zinte ahi a, a kicial nasemte ahi zongin ne lo ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin siampipa in sum tawh mi a lei leh tua mi in ne thei ding hi; tua bang hi loin a inn sunga suak sila ahih leh zong, a sila in a an ne thei ding hi.
Siampipa’ tanu in siampi ahi lo adang khat a tenpih leh, tua nu in a siangtho biakna ante khatbeek zong ne lo ding hi.

Ahih hangin siampipa’ tanu pen meigong ahih keileh a kima hi-in ta a neih kei leh a khang moi lai-in a pa’ inn ah a ciahkik khit leh, tua nu in a pa’ an ne thei ding hi; ahih hangin thunei mi ahi lo peuhmah in tuate khatbeek ne lo ding hi.
Khatpeuh in theih khialhna tawh a siangtho biakna an a nek khak leh, tua a na manzah seh-nga-ah-seh-khat behlapin, amah in siampipa tungah biakna an ditkikna bawl pelmawh ding hi.
Israyl mite in Yahweh’ tungah a piak uh a siangtho biaknate siampite in ninsakin simmawh bawl peuhmah lo ding uh a,
tua bangin amaute biakna siangtho ante nek ding phalna leh liau nading khialhna amaute tungah a tungsak kei ding uh hi. Kei pen amaute tuamkoihin a siangthosak Yahweh ka hi hi,’ ci in” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah a gen inah:

“Aaron leh a tapate, leh Israyl mite kiangah thugen inla, amaute kiangah, ‘Israyl innkuan panin pasal khat peuh ahi a, Israyl-te laka a teng peemta khat peuh ahi zongin, a kiciamna khatpeuh hanga biakpiakna hitaleh, Yahweh’ tungah meihal biakna-in amaute in a piak uh uttawmna hanga biaknate khatpeuh hitaleh,
note in bawnghonte, tuute, ahih keileh keelte lak panin sitbaang loin liamma a nei lo apa khat note’ tangin a kisang thei dingin na pia pelmawh ding uh hi.
A sitbaang ahih keileh liamma a nei peuhmah note in na pia peuhmah kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh note’ tangin tua pen santheih hi lo ding hi.

A tuamvilvel ama kiciamna a tangtung nadingin Yahweh’ tungah thunuam-a biakna ahi a, uttawmna hanga biakna bangin ahi zongin a pia peuhmah in, bawnghon ahih keileh tuute panin la ding a, tua pen a kisang thei dingin deih bang lian hi hamtang ding hi. Tua lai-ah liamma khat zong om lo ding hi.

Ganhing mittaw, a liam, a hem ahi a, cimeeng khatpeuh ahi zongin, meima naiphual ahih keileh meima nai luang a neite pen Yahweh’ tungah pia kei un. Yahweh’ tungah mei tawh kihal biakna-in biaknatau tungah hihte khatpeuh koih kei un.

Ahi zongin note in uttawmna hanga biakna-in a poi ahih keileh a khanciip ahi: bawngpi ahi a, bawngtal ahi a, tuu ahi zongin na pia thei ding uh a, ahih hangin tua pen kiciamna a tangtungsak dingin kisang lo ding hi.

A ciltangte a sidup gawp, a kisuzan, a kitam, ahih keileh a ki-atkhia ganhing khatpeuh Yahweh’ tungah na pia peuhmah kei ding uh hi. Note in na gam sung mahmah uh ah hih bangin na gamta peuhmah kei ding uh a,

gamdang mi khatpeuh khut panin tua bang ganhingte zong na sangin note Vantung Pa aa dingin anin tuate na pia peuhmah kei ding uh hi. Note tangin tuate kisang lo ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh tuate pen poi-in a hem hi,’ ci in,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah:

“Bawngpi ahi a, bawngtal ahi a, tuu ahi a, keel ahi zongin a suah ciangin, a pi tawh ni sagih sung kikoih khawm ding hi. A ni giat ni panin Yahweh’ tungah mei tawh kihal biakna-in tua pen kisang thei ding hi.
Bawngpi ahi a, tuupi ahi zongin amah leh a no ni khat sungin go khawm kei in.
Note in Yahweh’ tungah lungdam koh biakna na piak ciangun, note hong kisan theih nadingin pia un.
Tua pen a tua ni mahin kine pah ding hi; note in zingsang dong bangmah na siit kei ding uh hi; Kei pen Yahweh ka hi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin note in Ka Thukhamte zui-in na tang ding uh a, tuate na sem ding uh hi; Kei pen Yahweh ka hi hi.
Note in Ka Min Siangtho na daisak kei ding uh a, Israyl’ mite lak ah a Siangtho ka hi ding hi. Kei pen note hong siangsak leh a siangtho-in hong tuamkoih Yahweh ka hi hi;
note’ Vantung Pa ahi dingin Egypt gam panin note hong paikhiatpihpa ka hi hi. Kei pen Yahweh ka hi hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah a gen inah:
“Israyl mite hopih inla, amaute kiangah, ‘A Siangtho Kikhopnate a nei dingin note in na tangko ding uh Yahweh’ Pawite tawh kisai-in; hihte pen Keima Pawite ahi hi:

Niguk sung nasep kizokhin ding a, ahih hangin a ni Sagih Ni pen a thupi tawlngakna Shabbat, A Siangtho Kikhop ni ahi hi. Tua ni-in note in na na sem kei ding uh hi. Note tenna mun khempeuh ah hih pen Yahweh’ Shabbat ahi hi.
Hihte pen a kiseh hunte ah na tangko ding uh, A Siangtho Kikhopnate ahi Yahweh’ Pawite ahi hi:
A Kha Masa ni sawm le ni li ni, nitak nih kikalin Yahweh’ Paisan Biakpiakna kigo ding hi.
Tua kha mah a ni sawm le ni nga ni pen Yahweh aa dingin Silngo Sawh loh Anlum Pawi ahi a, ni sagih sung note in silngo kisawh lo anlum na ne ding uh hi.
A ni masa ni-in note in a Siangtho Kikhopna khat na nei ding uh hi; tua ni-in note in na nasep ngeite uh na sem kei ding uh a,

ahih hangin Yahweh’ tungah mei tawh a kihal biakna ni sagih sung na pia ding uh hi. A ni sagih ni pen a Siangtho Kikhopna khat ahi hi; tua ni-in note in na nasep ngeite uh na sem kei ding uh hi,’ ci in” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah a gen inah:

“Israyl mite kiangah thugen inla, amaute kiangah, ‘Note tungah ka hong piak leitang ah tungin note in an na lak uh ciangin, note in na anlakna panin anpal lom khat siampipa kiangah na paipih ding uh hi.
Note hong kisan theih nadingin amah in Yahweh mai-ah tua anlom pen vei ding hi. A Siangtho Ni Masa Ni ahi Shabbat Ni khit ciangin siampipa in vei ding hi.
Note in anlom na vei uh ciangin Yahweh’ tungah meihal biakna-in a sitbaang lo ahih keileh liamma a nei lo khum khat a pha tuuno apa khat tua ni-in na pia ding uh hi.

Omer An tawh Biakna pen a lungkimhuai gim namtui dingin Yahweh’ tungah mei tawh kihal biakna, sathau tawh kipawi annel limci ephah khat seh-sawm-suah-seh-nih hi ding a, dawn-a biakna pen leenggah zu hin khat seh-li-suah-seh-khat hi ding hi.

Note in Yahweh’ tungah hih Omer biakna na paipih ni tektek khit matengin, anlum hitaleh, a ki-em an hitaleh, an thak hitaleh na ne kei ding uh hi. Hih pen note tenna mun khempeuh ah a khangkhangin a kip den tawntung ngeina kip khat ahi ding hi.
Note in A Siangtho Ni Masa Shabbat ni khit— vei-a biakna anlom na paipih ni uh-a kipan na simto ding uh a, kaal sagih bit ding hi.
A kaal sagihna khit a zingciang dong ni 50 na simto ding a, tua ciangin note in Yahweh’ tungah an thak tawh biakna na pia ding uh hi.
Annel limci ephah khat seh-sawm-suah-seh-nih tawh a kibawl vei-a biakna anlum nih, na tenna munte uh panin na paipih ding uh hi. Tuate pen ci sawhin a ki-em, Yahweh’ tungah Anpal hi ding hi.

Note in anlum tawh a sitbaang lo kum khat a pha tuuno sagih, bawngtal khang lai khat, leh tuutal nih na pia ding uh hi. Tuate pen amau’ antawh biaknate, dawn-a biaknate, Yahweh’ tungah a lungkimhuai gim namtui dingin mei tawh kihal biakpiakna tawh Yahweh’ tungah meihal biakna ahi ding hi.
Tua khit ciangin mawhna hanga biakna-in keelno khat leh thunuam-a biakna biakpiakna-in kum khat a pha tuuno apa nih na go ding uh hi.
Siampipa in Yahweh mai-ah vei-a biakna-in Anpal anlum leh tuuno nih tawh tuate vei ding hi. Siampite aa dingin Yahweh’ tungah tuate a siangtho hi ding hi.

Note in a Siangtho Kikhopna na neih na dingun tua ni mahin, ‘Shabuot; Nipikalte’ Pawi, Anpal Pawi,” ci-in na tangko ding uh hi. Tua ni-in note in na nasep ngeite uh na sem kei ding uh hi. Tua pen a khangkhangin note tenna mun khempeuh ah a kip den tawntung ngeina kip khat ahi hi.

Note in na leitang panun an na lak uh ciangun, na lo nawl dong uh la loin, an na lak khit uh ciangin a sangte zong na khawm kei ding uh hi. Tuate pen a zawngte aa ding leh khualmite aa dingin na nusia ding uh hi. Kei pen Yahweh note Vantung Pa ka hi hi,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah a gen inah:
“Israyl mite kiangah hi bangin gen in, ‘A Kha Sagihna Kha sung, tua Kha Ni khat ni-in Peengkulte a Kimut Phawkna; Peengkul Pawi, A Siangtho Kikhopna, Shabbat khat na nei ding uh hi.
Tua ni-in note in na nasep ngeite uh na sem kei ding uh hi; ahi zongin Yahweh’ tungah mei tawh kihal biakna na pia ding uh hi,’ ci in” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah a gen inah:

“Tua banah hih a Kha Sagihna kha Ni Sawm ni pen Mawhkhuhna Ni ahi hi. Hih pen note aa dingin a Siangtho Kikhopna khat ahi hi. Note in na kha uh na gawt ding uh a, Yahweh’ tungah mei tawh kibawl biakna na pia ding uh hi.
Note in tua ni-in na nasep khempeuh uh na sem kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh tua pen Yahweh na Pa’ mai-ah note aa dingin mawhphelna a kibawl nadingin Mawhkhuhna Ni1 ahi hi.
Tua ni-in amah mah a kigawt2 lo mi peuhmah, a mipihte kiang panin kihawlkhia ding hi.
Tua ni-in nasep khatpeuh a sem mi peuhmah, a mipihte kiang panin kibeimangsak ding hi.
Note in nasep khatpeuh na sem nawn kei ding uh hi; tua pen note omna ding na tenna mun khempeuh ah a khangkhangin a kip den tawntung ngeina kip khat ahi ding hi.

Tua pen note aa dingin tawlngak Shabbat khat hi a, nomau mah na kigawt ding uh hi. Tua kha a ni kua ni nitaka kipan; ni tum pan kipan, a ni sawm ni nitak dong; ni tum dong, nitak panin nitakkik dong note in na Shabbat uh na tang ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah a gen inah:
“Israyl mite kiangah hi bangin gen in, ‘Hih a Kha Sagihna ni sawm le ni nga Ni panin Yahweh’ tungah Buk Pawi, ni sagih sung ahi hi.
A ni khat ni-in A Siangtho Kikhopna khat om ding a, tua ni-in note in na nasep ngeite uh na sem kei ding uh hi;

Ahih hangin ni sagih sung Yahweh’ tungah mei tawh kihal biakna na pia ding uh hi. A ni giat ni-in note in A Siangtho Kikhopna na nei ding uh a, (A Nunung Ni Lian Ni) Yahweh’ tungah mei tawh kihal biakna na pia ding uh hi. Tua pen Yahweh’ Kum Siangtho Kikaihkhopna a tawpna hi a, tua ni-in na ut peuhpeuh uh sem loin, na nasep ngeite zong na sem kei ding uh hih.

Hihte pen note in A Siangtho Kikhop nading, Yahweh’ tungah mei tawh kihal biakna piak nading, a ni ni-in a kihih ding meihal biakna, an tawh biakna, biakpiakna, leh dawn-a biaknate hi ci-in na tangko ding uh Yahweh’ Pawite ahi hi.
Hih biakna piaknate pen Yahweh’ Shabbat-te behlapna, note’ citpiaknate, leh na kiciamsa peuhpeuh, leh Yahweh’ tungah na piak uh uttawmna hanga biaknate khempeuh a behlapna ahi hi.

Tua ahih manin a Kha Sagihna a ni sawm le ni nga Ni-in note in na leitang uh panin ante na kaihkhopkhit uh ciangin, ni sagih sung note in Yahweh’ tungah pel loin Pawi na kham ding uh hi. A ni khat ni-in Shabbat khat om ding a, a ni giat ni-in zong Shabbat khat om ding hi.
Tua ni ma-in singkungte panin a gahte tengin, nisuh hiangte, a bawkpha hiangte leh gialhekte na la ding uh a, ni sagih sung Yahweh’ note Pa’ mai-ah nuamsa takin na om ding uh hi.

Khut khatin ni sagih sung Yahweh’ tungah Pawi khat-in na mang ding uh hi. Tua pen note khang tawntungin a kip den ngeina kip khat ahi ding hi. Note in a Kha Sagihna kha sungin tua pawi na kham ding uh hi.
Ni sagih sung a kibawl pak bukte sungah na om ding uh hi. Israyl mi ahi tualsuak mi khempeuh bukte sungah om ding uh a,
Egypt gam panin Israyl mite Ka paikhiatpih ciangin, bukte sunga a om dingin amaute Ka bawlna na suanlekhakte in a theih nading uh ahi hi; Kei pen Yahweh note Vantung Pa ka hi hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Mosheh in Israyl mite kiangah Yahweh’ Pawite a genkhia hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah a gen inah:
“Israyl mite in meivak aa dingin olive kigawi a siangtho sathau na kiangah hong paipih na dingin thu pia in, tua hileh meivak pen kivak suaksuak ding hi.

Tecipanna-a Dalna puan pualam, Mun Siangtho sungah Aaron in Yahweh mai-ah nitak panin zingsang dongin tua pen a vak suaksuak ding hi; tua pen na khangkhangun a kip den tawntung ngeina kip khat ahi hi.
Yahweh mai-a kham citak meivakkhuam tunga meivakte pen kivil tawntung ding hi.
Annel limci la inla, tua tawh mohluum sawm le nih em in. Mohluum khat ciat bawl nadingin annel limci ephah khat seh-sawm-suah-seh-nih kizang ding hi.
Yahweh’ mai-a kham citak sabuai tungah tuate gual nihin na koih ding a, gual khat ah guk om ding hi.
Anlum piak nadingin leh Yahweh’ tungah mei tawh kihal biak nadingin phawkna sehtanhin gual khat ciat ah paknamtui citak koih in.
Shabbat khat khit Shabbat khat, Shabbat simin Israyl mite tangin bei hun nei lo tawntung thuciamna-in amah in Yahweh mai-ah hoih takin gual den ding hi.

Tua pen Aaron leh a tapate aa ding hi a, amaute in mun siangtho sungah ne ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh tua pen a om tawntung thuciamna tawh Yahweh’ tungah mei tawh kihal biakpiaknate panin amau ngah det sehtanh a siangtho pen amau aituam ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Tu-in Israyl mi numei khat’ tapa, a pa Egypt mi ahi khat, Israyl mite lakah a pai hi; Giahphual sungah hih Israyl mi numei’ tapa leh Israyl pasal khat, khatlekhat a kilai uh hi.
Israyl mi numei’ tapa in samsiatna tawh Yahweh’ Min a simmawh bawl hi. Tua ahih manin amaute in tua pa Mosheh kiangah paipih uh hi. (A nu’ min pen Shelomith hi a, Dan minam panin Dibri’ tanu ahi hi.)
Tua tak ciangin Yahweh’ deihna amaute tungah a kitelciat matengin amaute in tua pa a khumcip uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah a gen inah:
“Giahphual pua lamah a samsia mipa paipih unla, tua pa gen thu a za mi khempeuh in tua pa lutungah a khutte uh nga-in mihon buppi in suang tawh denglum ding uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin nangmah in Israyl mite kiangah, ‘Mi khatpeuh in Yahweh a samsiat leh, amah in ama mawhna pua ding hi;

Yahweh’ Min a simmawh bawl mi khatpeuh kithat lum ding hi. Mihon khempeuh in tua mi denglum pelmawh ding hi; tualsuak gamdang mi khatpeuh zong tua mah bangin kibawl ding hi. Amah in Yahweh’ Min a thaangzat2 ciangin, amah kithat ding hi.
A nungta lai mi khatpeuh nuntakna a la mi peuhmah kithat ding hi.
Mi khatpeuh ganhing a that peuhmah in nuntakna tang ding nuntakna mah tawh ditkikna bawl pelmawh ding hi.
Mi khatpeuh in a sanggampa a liamsak leh, ama hihsa bangbangin ama tungah kihihkik ding hi:
Guh kitan tang ding guh kitan, mittang tang ding mittang, hatang tang ding hatang kihihkik ding hi. Amah in mi khat a poisak bangin amah kipoisak ding hi.
Ganhing a that peuhmah in ditkikna bawl pelmawh ding hi; ahih hangin mi a that peuhmah kithat pelmawh ding hi.
Peemta aa ding leh tualsuak mi aa dingin a kibang Thukham na nei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Kei pen Yahweh note Pa ka hi hi,” a ci hi.

Tua tak ciangin Mosheh in Israyl mite kiangah thugen a, amaute in giahphual pualam ah a samsiapa paipihin suangte tawh a denglum hi. Tua ahih manin Yahweh in Mosheh thu a piak bangin Israyl mite in a hih uh hi.
Sinai Mual tungah Yahweh in Mosheh hopihin a gen inah:
“Israyl mite kiangah thugen inla, amaute kiangah, ‘Note Ka hong piakna gam sungah na tun uh ciangin, leitang in Yahweh’ tungah Shabbat tang ding hi.
Note in kum guk sung na lo uh na pai ding uh a, kum guk sung na leenggui lo uh hahin a gahte na kaikhawm ding uh hi;

Ahih hangin a Kum Sagihna kum ciangin leitang aa dingin a thupi tawlngakna Shabbat hi a, Yahweh’ tungah Shabbat khat ahi hi. Note in na lo uh na pawi kei ding uh a, na leenggui lo uh zong na hah kei ding uh hi.
A li pote note in na kaikhawm kei ding uh a, a kipuah lo leenggui gahte zong na khawm kei ding uh hi. Leitang in tawlngak kum a neih ding ahi hi.
Kum Shabbat sungin leitang in a piansak peuhpeuh note aa ding, na nasem pasal leh na nasem numeite aa ding, a kicial nasemte aa ding, note laka hong peem khualmite aa ding,
na gam sunga na gankhawite uh leh na ganhingte uh aa ding hi a, leitang panin piang khempeuh an ding ahi hi.
Kum sagih, sagih vei, kum Shabbat sagih na simto ding uh a, kum Shabbat sagih hun pen kum 49 hi ding hi.
Tua tak ciangin note in a Kha Sagihna Kha Ni Sawm Ni-in mun khempeuh ah Jubilee peengkul na gingsak ding uh a, Mawhkhuhna ni-in na gam sung khempeuh uh ah peengkul na gingsak ding uh hi.

A kum 50-na kum sehtuam unla, gamsung khempeuh-a a teng khempeuh tungah suahtakna tangko un. Tua pen note aa dingin Jubilee khat hi ding hi; note lak panin khat ciat in a neihsa ngahkikin, note lak panin khat ciat a innkuanpihte kiangah ciahkik ding uh hi.
Tua a kum 50-na kum pen note aa dingin Jubilee ahi hi. Tua kum sungin note in lo pawi loin, a lipote zong la loin, a kihah lo leengguite panin zong leenggah na khawm kei ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh tua pen jubilee ahi hi. Tua pen note aa dingin a siangtho ahi hi; note in lo panin a piangte na ne kei ding uh hi.
Hih Jubilee Kum sungin note lak panin khat ciat in a neihsa ngahkik ding hi.
Note in na vengte kiangah na khat peuhpeuh zuakin ahih keileh na vengte khut panin na lei leh, khatlekhat na kikhem kei ding uh hi.
Jubilee khit-a kum phazah tawh kituakin na sanggampa kiang panin na lei ding ahi hi. Anlak nadingin kum a cianlai zah tawh kituakin amah in a zuak ding ahi hi.
Kum tam a cianlai leh, note in na tammansak ding uh a, kum tawm a cianlai leh, note in a man na khiam ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh, amah in an a kila ding zah hong zuak ahi hi.
Note Pa na zahtakna uh tawh khatlekhat a meet kidok kei un; bang hang hiam cihleh Kei pen Yahweh note Pa ka hi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin note in Ka ngeina kipte zui-in Ka thukhennate kemcing unla, zui-in tuate na sem ding uh a, tua leitang ah lungmuang takin na teng ding uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin leitang in an hong piangsak ding a, note in na khamtakun ne-in, tua gam ah lungmuang takin na teng ding uh hi.
Note in, ‘Lo lah pawi loin, an lah la kei lehang, a kum sagihna ah bang ne ding ihi hiam?’ na cih uh leh,
leitang in kum thum sung khom ding an hong piangsak nadingin Keimah in a Kum Gukna kumin note tungah thupha kong pia ding hi.
A kum giatna ah lo na pawi sungun, note in anlui na ne lai ding uh a, a kum kua-na anthak hong tun matengin an lui na ne toto lai ding uh hi.
Leitang pen neihsuak dingin na zuak kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh leitang pen Keima aa hi a, note pen peemtate leh Ka leitang hong kawmte na hi uh hi.
Neihsa bangin na let uh leitang khempeuh ah leitang tatna na bawl hamtang ding uh hi.
Na sanggamte khatpeuh zawngin ama neihsa khenkhat a zuak leh, amah tawh a kinai a behpa hong pai-in a sanggampa’ zuaksa tan ding hi.
Ahih hangin ama aa dingin a tatsak ding mi om loin, ahi zongin amah mah in tan zo dingin a hauhkik leh,
tua ciangin a zuak khit-a kipanin kumte kisimsak ding a, ama neihsa a ngahkik theih nadingin a zuakna mipa tungah a kituakin piakik ding hi.

Ahih hangin amah in ama aa dingin ngahkik zawh nading lampi a nei kei leh, tua ama zuak leitang pen Jubilee kum mateng a leipa’ khut sungah om ding hi. Tua ciangin Jubilee kum ciangin tua leitang kipiakik ding a, amah in a neihsa ngahkik ding hi.
Mi khat in khuapikulh sunga inn khatpeuh a zuak leh amah in a kizuak khit kum khat bit sungin amah in tankik thei ding hi; kum khat bit sungin amah in tua pen tankik thei ding hi.
Ahih hangin tua pen kum khat bit sungin a kitatkik kei leh, khuapikulh sunga inn pen a leipa in a neih suak ding ahi hi. Tua pen Jubilee kum ciangin kipiakik nawn lo ding hi.
Ahih hangin a kiimkot-a kulh a nei lo khua neu-a innte pen gam sung mun awng mah bangin kingaihsun ding hi. Tuate pen kitankik thei ding a, Jubilee kum ciangin tuate kipiakik ding hi.
Levi mite in amaute tennate ahi Levi mite’ khuapi sunga amau’ innte a tawntungin tatkik theihna thu nei uh hi.

Tua ahih manin Levi mite neihsa pen a kitan thei hi a, (Tua pen amaute let khuapi sunga a kizuak inn khatpeuh hi a) Jubilee kum ciangin a kipiakik ding ahi hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Levi mite’ khuapite sunga innte pen Israyl mite laka amau’ neihsa ahi hi.
Ahih hangin amau’ khuapi taang gamte kizuak thei peuhmah lo ding hi; ahang in tua pen amau’ neih tawntung ahi hi.
Na sanggamte khatpeuh zawngin note lak ah ama-le-amah a kivak zawh kei leh, khualmi ahi a, peemta ahi zongin na huh bangun na huh ding uh hi, tua hileh note lak ah amah hong teng suak thei ding hi.
Na sanggampa uh note tawh hong ten theih nadingin ama kiang panin a meet khatpeuh la loin na Pa uh zahtak un.
Note in ama tungah a meetin sum leitawi na pia kei ding uh a, ama tungah a meetin na an uh zong na leitawi kei ding uh hi.
Kei pen Canaan gam note hong pia ding leh note Vantung Pa hi dingin Egypt gam panin hong paikhiatpih Yahweh note Pa ka hi hi.
Na sanggamte uh khatpeuh note lak ah zawngin amahmah hong kizuak leh, sila bangin na semsak kei un.
Amah pen a kicial nasem ahih keileh note laka peemta bangin na bawl ding uh hi; amah in Jubilee Kum mateng nang aa dingin nasem ding hi.
Tua khit ciangin amah leh a tate kisuaktasak ding a, ama behte kiang ciahkikin a pu a pate’ neihsa ngahkik ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Israyl mite pen Egypt gam panin Keimah in ka paikhiatpih Ka nasemte hi a, amaute sila bangin kizuak peuhmah lo ding uh hi.
Note in amah tungah hih gawpgawpin na uk kei ding uh a, note Vantung Pa na zahtak ding uh hi.
Na sila pasal na sila numeite uh pen note kiimkot-a minamte panin hi ding uh a, tuate panin note in silate na lei thei ding uh hi.
Note in note laka hong teng peemta pawlkhat leh na gam sunga suak amau’ beh sung mite zong na lei thei ding uh a, amaute pen no neihsa suak ding hi.

Note in amaute pen note’ khit ciangin na tapate uh tungah amau’ neih dingin a luah dingin na pia thei ding uh hi; note in sila-in amaute na nei tawntung thei ding uh hi. Ahih hangin na sanggam uh Israyl mite khatlekhat hih gawpgawpna tawh na ki-uk kei ding uh hi.
Note laka peemta ahih keileh khualmi khatpeuh hong hau-in, na sanggamte uh khatpeuh zawngin note laka peemta ahih keileh khualmi tungah amahmah a kizuak leh,
amah a kizuak khit ciangin amah kitankik thei ding a, ama sanggamte khat peuhpeuh in amah tan thei ding hi:
Ama innlak pa ahih keileh a innlak sanggam ahih keileh a behte sunga a sisan kinaipih khatpeuh in amah tan thei ding hi. Tua bang hi loin amah a hauh leh, amah leh amah kitan thei ding hi.
Amah leh amah a leipa in amah a kizuak kum pana kipan Jubilee kum dong simto ding uh hi. Ama suahtak nading sum pen tua kum phazah sunga a kicial mipa thaman tungah kinga ding hi.
Kum tampi a sap lai leh, ama piak ding zah sangin a tamzaw ama kitatna dingin pia hamtang ding hi.
Jubilee kum ding kum tawmkhat bek in a sap leh, amah in tuat dinga ama kitatna ding tawh kituakin pia ding hi.
Amah pen kum khat khit kum khat a kicial mipa bangin kibawl ding hi; a pu in amah tungah hih gawpgawpin a ukna peuhmah amah in thuak peuhmah lo ding hi.
Hih bang dante khatbeek tawh amah a kitat kei leh zong, Jubilee Kum ciangin amah leh a tate kisuaktasak ding hi;
Bang hang hiam cihleh Israyl mite pen nasemte bangin Keima aa ahi hi. Amaute pen Egypt gam panin Ka paikhiatpih Ka nasemte ahi hi. Kei pen Yahweh note Vantung Pa ka hi hi.

Note aa dingin pasiante hitaleh, milim hitaleh, nomau’ mah phuh tawm biakna khuamte hitaleh na bawl kei ding uh a, a mai ah na kun dingun suang milim zong na phut kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Kei pen Yahweh note Pa ka hi hi.
Ka Biakbuk Siangtho ah Ka Shabbat-te zuihna tawh Keimah nong zahtak ding uh hi. Kei pen Yahweh ka hi hi.
Note in Ka ngeina kipte zui-in Ka Thukhamte mangin, tuate semin na gamtat uh leh,
A hunhunin note guahtui kong pia ding a, leitang in an hong piaksakin, lo sunga singkungte in amau’ gah gah ding uh hi.

Na cil uh ante leenggah lawh hun dong kimang ding a, leenggah minte zong lopawi hun dong kimang ding hi. Note in na kham takun an na ne ding uh a, na gam sung uh ah lungmuang takin na teng ding uh hi.

Keimah in gam sungah nopsakna kong pia ding a, note lungnuam takin lumin kuamah in note hong lausak lo ding uh hi; Keimah in gam sung panin ganhing gilote ka hawlkhia ding a, namsau in na gam sung uh hong nawk lo ding hi.
Note in na galte uh na notkhia ding uh a, note’ mai-ah namsau hangin amaute puk ding uh hi.
Note nga in za khat zo-in, tul sawm a do dingin note za khat na kuan ding uh hi; note mai-ah namsau hangin na galte uh puk ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Keimah in note ka hong angvanin kong cing ding a, note hong pungsakin, tampi kong phasak ding a, note tawh Ka thuciamna ka kipsak ding hi.
Note in kum lui an na ne ding uh a, a thak hangin a lui na hah siang ding uh hi.
Keimah in note lakah Ka biakbuk ka phut ding a, note kong mudah kei ding hi.
Note lakah pai-in na Pa uh ka hi ding a, note pen Ka mite na hi ding uh hi.
Kei pen Egypt mite sila ahi lo dingin Egypt gam panin note hong paikhiatpih Yahweh note Pa ka hi hi; Keimah in note gimna hakkol ka kuaitan a, note tang takin a pai dingin kong bawl hi.
Ahih hangin Ka thu hong mang loin, hih Thukhamte khempeuh zui loin na hih loin,
Ka Ngeinakipte nialin ahih keileh Ka Thukhennate mudahin, tua ahih manin Ka Thukhamte khempeuh zui loin sem loin, Ka Thuciamna na palsat uh leh,

Keimah in note tungah hihte kong hih ding hi: note’ tungah hong tung dingin Keimah in thakhatthu a dipkuatna, zawngkhalna, leh na khuamuhna uh a susia ding leh nuntakna a kiamsak ding cisa natna kong tungsak ding hi. Lo na pawi uh hangin a mawkna hi ding a, bang hang hiam cihleh na galte un ne mang ding hi.

Keimah in note langah Ka mai ka ngat ding a, tua hileh na galte hangin note hong kizogawp ding hi; note hong mudah mite in note tungah hong uk ding uh a, note hong kinung delh loh nangawn ciangin zong na taimang ding uh hi.
Hihte khempeuh khit ah Ka thu nong ngaih kei veve uh leh, na mawhnate uh hangin Keimah in a zah sagih vei-in note dan kong thuaksak ding hi.
Keimah in note genhakin na kiphatsakna uh ka sukham ding a, note tunga vanpi sik bangin bawlin na leitung uh sumngo bangin ka bawl ding hi.
Note thahatna pen a mawkna-in kibeisak ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh leitang in an piangsak lo ding a, leitang-a singkungte in zong a gah gah lo ding hi.
Tua tak ciangin Kei hong langbawlin gamta-in, Ka thu zuih ding na ut kei lailai uh leh, Keimah in na mawhnate uh tawh kituakin note thuaknate a zah sagih vei valin ka khangsak ding hi.

Gamsa gilote note langah Ka sawl ding a, amaute in na tate uh hong tuahsakin na ganhonte uh susia-in, na lampite uh gamkhing suakin a hawmpi a suah nadingin note tawmno khat a pha-in Ka hong bawl ding hi.
Hih bang teng hi napi Ka hong puahphatna na sannop kei-a Keima hangin kipuahpha tuan loin, Kei hong langbawlin na gamtat veve uh leh,
tua ciangin Keimah in note ka hong langbawl ding a, na mawhnate hangin a zah sagih veival kong dantat beh lai ding hi.

Ka Thuciamna palsatna hanga phu a la ding namsau note tungah kong tungsak ding hi. Na khuapite sungah na nungkikin na kikaihkhop uh ciangin, note lakah pulnatna kong puak ding a, note pen na galte’ khut sungah hong kipia ding hi.

Keimah in note an hong sikte ka beimangsak ciangin, numei sawm in tuk khat ah anlum em khawm thei ding uh a, tawiteh tektekin anlum a hawmkhia ding uh hi. Na ne ding uh a, ahih hangin na kham zo kei ding uh hi.
Hih bang teng hi napi Ka thu hong mang loin, Kei hong langbawlin na gamtat veve uh leh,
tua ciangin Keimah in note hong langneihin Ka hehna kizom to lai ding a, Kei, Keimah nangawn, in na mawhnate uh hangin a zah sagih vei valin kong thuhilh ding hi.
Note in na tapate uh sa na ne ding uh a, note in na tanute uh sa na ne ding uh hi.

Keimah in na mun sangte uh, na paknamtui biaknataute uh ka vatmai ding a, nuntakna a nei lo na pasian limte (elohim, teraphim) uh tungah na luangte uh ka pai ding hi; Keimah in note kong mudah ding hi.
Keimah in na khuapite uh ka susiamang ding a, na munsiangthote uh gamkhing ka suaksak ding a, Keima in a lungkimhuai na gim namtui biakna’ gimnam ka diik kei ding hi.
Keimah in leitang ka siasak ding a, tua lai-a teng na galte un lamdangsa ding hi.
Keimah in minamte lakah note ka hong thehthang ding a, note lamah namsau ka dokkhia ding hi; na gam uh gamkhing suak ding a, na khuapite uh mangthang ding hi.
Tua tak ciangin na gam uh gamkhingin a om laiteng leh na galte gam sungah na om laitengin leitang in a Shabbat-te nuamsa ding hi; tua ciangin leitang tawlnga ding a, a Shabbat-te ah nuamsa ding hi.
Ama tungah na ten laitakun na ngahsak loh uh tawlngakna ahi Shabbat-te, gamkhinga a om tanvei tawlngakna a ngah hi ding hi.

Huihmutsa nahthel ging in amaute a taimang dingin note’ sung panin a galte’ leitangte ah a omlai mite tungah a lungsim uh ka lauthawngsak mahmah ding hi. Kuamah nangawn in amaute a delh loh hangin namsau kihta-a tai bangin amaute tai ding uh a, a puk ding uh hi.
Kuamah nangawn in amaute a delh loh hangin namsau kihta-a tai bangin khatlekhat kinawkpaigawp ding uh hi. Tua ahih manin na galte uh a nangzo ding na hi kei uh hi.
Minamte lakah na mangthang ding uh a, na galte uh leitang in note hong netum ding hi.
Note sung panin a omlai teng pen a galte uh gamte-a amau’ gamtatsiatna hangin mangthang ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin amaute in amau mawhnate leh a pate uh mawhnate hong pulak uh leh, Kei tunga amaute hong cihtak lohna uh—Kei hong langbawlin na gamtatna te uh zong,
a galte gam sungah amaute ka puak theih nadinga amaute in Kei hong langneihsaknate uh—tua ciangin amaute’ lungsim vut-at lohna panin kiniamkhiatin, hih mawhna man ding amaute in a piak uh ciangin,
Keimah in Yaaqob tawh Ka thuciamna, Isaac tawh Ka thuciamna leh Abraham tawh Ka thuciamna ka phawk ding a, leitang zong Ka phawk ding hi.

Amaute in leitang zong a hawmpi-in nusia ding uh a, amaute om loin gamkhingin a om sungteng leitang in a Shabbat-te ah nuamsa ding hi; amaute mawhna amau mah in thuak ding uh hi, bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in Ka Thukhennate nialin Ka Ngeina Kipte mudah uh hi.

Hih bang hi napi-in, a galte uh gam sungah amaute a om ciangin, Keimah in amaute nial loin amaute susia maimang zah ding leh amaute tawh Ka thuciamna pelh zah dong dingin ka mudah kei ding hi. Kei pen Yahweh note Pa ka hi hi.
Ahih hangin Keimah in amaute ka ngaihsutna-in amaute Pa ka hih nadingin minamte muhna ah Egypt gam panin Ka paikhiatpih amau’ pulepate thuciamna Ka phawk ding hi,” a ci hi.
Hihte pen Sinai Mual tungah Mosheh khut tawh kigelh Israyl mite leh Yahweh mahmah kikal-a Yahweh’ bawl Ngeinate, Thukhennate leh Thukhamte ahi hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah a gen inah:
“Israyl mite kiangah thugen inla, amaute kiangah, ‘A kituak zah man piakna tawh Yahweh’ tungah a tuam vilvel kiciamna-in mi khat na sehtuam ciangin,
pasal kum 20 pan kum 60 kikal a phate’ man pen munsiangtho shekel tawh kizui-in ngun shekel 50 na seh ding hi.
Hih zahte kikal mah ahi numei ahih leh, ama man dingin ngun shekel 30 na seh ding hi.
Kum nga panin kum sawm nih kikal a pha mi ahih leh, pasal’ man dingin ngun shekel 20 seh inla, numei’ man dingin ngun shekel 10 seh in.
Kha khat panin kum nga kikal a pha mi ahih leh, pasal’ man dingin ngun shekel nga seh inla, numei’ man dingin ngun shekel thum seh in.
Kum 60 pan a tungsiah a pha mi ahih leh, pasal’ man dingin ngun shekel 15 seh inla, numei’ man dingin ngun shekel 10 seh in.

Kiciamna a bawl khatpeuh pen a tuam vilvel a kisehzah man a piak dingin a zawn luatleh, kiciamna a bawl ding mipa piak zawh zah ding tawh kizui-in mipa aa dingin man a sehsak ding siampipa kiangah amah in a mi hong paipih ding hi.
Ama kiciamna pen Yahweh’ tungah biakna-in a kisang thei ding ganhing ahih leh, Yahweh’ tungah a kipia tua bang ganhing pen a siangtho ahi hi.

Amah in a hoih khat pen a sia khat tawh, a sia khat pen a hoih khat tawh na khek kei ding uh a, zong na laih kei ding uh hi; Amah in ganhing khat pen adang khat tawh a khek leh, tua ganhing leh a khekna ganhing a siangtho hi khawm ding hi.
Ama kiciamna pen Yahweh’ tungah biakna-in a kisang thei lo ganhing siang lo ahih leh, siampipa tungah tua ganhing kipia pelmawh ding a,
amah in a hoihna ahi a, a hoih lohna ahi zongin khensat ding hi. Tua khit ciangin siampipa sehzahzah pen a man zah hi pah ding hi.
A neipa in a ganhing a tat nop leh, siampipa’ man sehzah tungah seh-nga-suah-seh-khat behlap hamtang ding hi.
Mi khat in Yahweh’ tungah a siangtho na-in a inn a ap leh, siampipa in a man zah seh ding a, tua zah mah hipah ding hi.
A inn a ap mipa in a tatkik leh, amah in a man zah banah seh-nga-suah-seh-khat behlap hamtang ding hi; tua ciangin inn pen ama aa hikik ding hi.

Mi khat in ama luah innkuan leitang khenkhat Yahweh’ tungah a ap leh, tua leitanga kivawh ding khaici phazah tawh kizui-in a man zah kiseh ding hi. Mangbuh tang homer khat man pen ngun shekel 50 hi ding hi.
Jubilee kum hun sungin amah in a logam a ap leh, a kiseh khinsa a man zah mah hi ding a,
ahih hangin Jubilee kum khit ciangin amah in a logam a ap leh, siampipa in a zom Jubilee kum dong a om lai kum phazah tawh kizui-in a man khensat ding hi; a man a kisehzah kikhiam ding hi.
Logam a ap pa in a logam a tatkik nop leh, tua ciangin amah in a kisehsa a man zah tungah seh-nga-suah-seh-khat behlap hamtang ding a, logam pen ama aa hikik ding hi.
Ahih hangin amah in logam pen a tatnop nawn kei a, ahih keileh mi dang khat kiangah a logam a zuakkhit ahih leh, tua pen cikmahin kitankik thei lo ding hi.
Jubilee ciangin logam pen a kipiakkhiat ciangin, tua pen Yahweh’ tungah a siangtho suak ding hi; a kipia paisuak logam bangin tua pen siampite’ neihsa suak ding hi.
Mi khat in ama luah a innkuan logam khenkhat ahi lo, a leisa logam Yahweh tungah a ap leh,
siampipa in Jubilee Kum dong tuatin a man zah seh ding a, mipa in siampipa’ man sehzah tua ni-in Yahweh tungah a siangtho biakna-in pia pelmawh ding hi.
Jubilee Kum sungin a logam pen a zuak pa, gamhluahna tawh tua logam a neipa tungah tungkik ding hi.
Man a kiseh peuhmah munsiangtho shekel tawh kizui-in kiseh ding hi; gerah 20 ciangin shekel khat ahi hi.
Kuamah in ganhing tacil peuhmah ap peuhmah lo ding hi; ahang in tacil peuhmah Yahweh aa ahi hi; ganhon lak pan ahi a, tuuhon lak pan ahi zongin tua pen Yahweh aa ahi hi.

Tua pen ganhing siang lo ahih leh, siampipa man sehna tawh kizui-in amah in tan thei ding a, a man zah tungah seh-nga-suah-seh-khat behlap ding hi. Tua pen a kitat kei leh, siampipa man sehna bangin kizuak ding hi.

Ahih hangin mi khat in bangmah a neih kei a, Yahweh’ tungah a siangtho biakna-in a kipum-ap leh, mihing ahi a, ganhing ahi a, ama luah leitang ahi zongin kizuak thei ding a, kitan thei ding hi; tua banga a ki-ap na khempeuh pen Yahweh tungah a siangtho pen ahi hi.
Mite lak nangawn panin a kisusiamang dingin a ki-apsa mi peuhmah, kitan thei lo ding hi. Amah pen pel loin kithat ding hi.
Leitang panin a piang khempeuh khaici hitaleh singgah hitaleh sawm-ah-khat khempeuh Yahweh aa ahi hi. Tua pen Yahweh tunga a siangtho ahi hi.
Mi khat in ama sawm-ah-khat panin khat peuhpeuh a tat nop leh, amah in a man zah tungah nga-ah-khat behlap pelmawh ding hi.
Bawnghon ahih keileh tuuhon pana sawm-ah-khat buppi; gancingpa ciangkhut nuai-ah a pai khempeuh panin sawm-ah-khat peuhmah Yahweh tungah a siangtho ahi hi.

Amah in a hoih lo lak panin a hoih tengkhia loin, khek zong khek peuhmah lo ding hi. Amah in a khek leh, a tengkhiat ganhing leh a khekna zong a siangtho hi ding a, kitan thei lo ding hi,’ ci-in’ a ci hi.
Hihte pen Israyl mite aa dingin Sinai Mual tungah Yahweh in Mosheh a piak Thukhamte ahi hi.
